q.zh: 英语单词 father 中的 a 音，最接近下列哪个中文韵母？
q.en: The 'a' sound in 'father' is closest to which Chinese final?

exp.zh: 单韵母 a 是开口元音，像英语 father 的 a。
exp.en: The final a is an open vowel, like 'a' in 'father'.

q.zh: 英语单词 more 中的 o 音，最接近下列哪个中文韵母？
q.en: The 'o' sound in 'more' is closest to which Chinese final?

exp.zh: 单韵母 o 是圆唇后元音，像英语 more 的 o。
exp.en: The final o is a rounded back vowel, like 'o' in 'more'.

q.zh: 英语单词 uh 中的音，最接近下列哪个中文韵母？
q.en: The 'uh' sound in English is closest to which Chinese final?

exp.zh: 单韵母 e 接近英语的 uh，如「饿 è」。
exp.en: The final e is close to English 'uh', as in 饿 (è).

q.zh: 英语单词 see 中的 ee 音，最接近下列哪个中文韵母？
q.en: The 'ee' sound in 'see' is closest to which Chinese final?

exp.zh: 单韵母 i 是前高元音，像英语 see 的 ee。
exp.en: The final i is a high front vowel, like 'ee' in 'see'.

q.zh: 英语单词 food 中的 oo 音，最接近下列哪个中文韵母？
q.en: The 'oo' sound in 'food' is closest to which Chinese final?

exp.zh: 单韵母 u 是圆唇后高元音，像英语 food 的 oo。
exp.en: The final u is a high back rounded vowel, like 'oo' in 'food'.

q.zh: 下列哪个是「前高圆唇」元音？
q.en: Which final is a high front rounded vowel?

exp.zh: ü 是前高圆唇元音，英语没有完全对应的音，可先发 i 再圆唇。
exp.en: ü is a high front rounded vowel. English has no exact equivalent; say 'i' then round your lips.

q.en: Which final is in 「女 nǚ」?

exp.zh: 女 nǚ 中的韵母是 ü。注意 j/q/x/y 后的 ü 写作 u（如 jū、qū、xū、yū）。
exp.en: 女 nǚ uses the final ü. After j/q/x/y, ü is written u (e.g. jū, qū, xū, yū).

q.zh: 英语单词 eye 中的音，最接近下列哪个中文韵母？
q.en: The 'eye' sound in English is closest to which Chinese final?

exp.zh: 复韵母 ai 像英语 eye 的音，如「爱 ài」。
exp.en: The final ai is like 'eye', as in 爱 (ài).

q.zh: 英语单词 pay 中的 ay 音，最接近下列哪个中文韵母？
q.en: The 'ay' sound in 'pay' is closest to which Chinese final?

exp.zh: 复韵母 ei 像英语 pay 的 ay，如「北 běi」。
exp.en: The final ei is like 'ay' in 'pay', as in 北 (běi).

q.zh: 英语单词 cow 中的 ow 音，最接近下列哪个中文韵母？
q.en: The 'ow' sound in 'cow' is closest to which Chinese final?

exp.zh: 复韵母 ao 像英语 cow 的 ow，如「好 hǎo」。
exp.en: The final ao is like 'ow' in 'cow', as in 好 (hǎo).

q.zh: 英语单词 go 中的 o 音，最接近下列哪个中文韵母？
q.en: The 'o' sound in 'go' is closest to which Chinese final?

exp.zh: 复韵母 ou 像英语 go 的 o，如「走 zǒu」。
exp.en: The final ou is like 'o' in 'go', as in 走 (zǒu).

q.zh: 英语单词 yeah 中的 ea 音，最接近下列哪个中文韵母？
q.en: The 'ea' sound in 'yeah' is closest to which Chinese final?

exp.zh: 复韵母 ie 像英语 yeah 的 ea，如「写 xiě」。
exp.en: The final ie is like 'ea' in 'yeah', as in 写 (xiě).

q.zh: 韵母 üe 的发音最接近？
q.en: Which best describes the pronunciation of üe?

exp.zh: üe 由 ü + e 组成，如「月 yuè」。注意 j/q/x/y 后的 üe 写作 ue。
exp.en: üe is composed of ü + e, as in 月 (yuè). After j/q/x/y, üe is written ue.

q.zh: 「儿子 ér zi」中「儿」的韵母是？
q.en: Which final is used in 「儿」 of 「儿子 ér zi」?

exp.zh: er 是卷舌元音，独立成音节。
exp.en: er is a retroflex vowel that forms its own syllable.

q.zh: 复韵母 ui 是下列哪两个音的合体？
q.en: Which two vowels combine to form the final ui?

exp.zh: ui 是 u + e + i 的缩写，如「对 duì」。
exp.en: ui is shorthand for u + e + i, as in 对 (duì).

q.zh: 复韵母 iu 是下列哪两个音的合体？
q.en: Which two vowels combine to form the final iu?

exp.zh: iu 是 i + e + u 的缩写，如「六 liù」。
exp.en: iu is shorthand for i + e + u, as in 六 (liù).

q.zh: 复韵母 un 是下列哪两个音的合体？
q.en: Which two sounds combine to form the final un?

exp.zh: un 是 u + en 的缩写，如「论 lùn」。
exp.en: un is shorthand for u + en, as in 论 (lùn).

q.zh: 复韵母 ün 是下列哪两个音的合体？
q.en: Which two sounds combine to form the final ün?

exp.zh: ün 是 ü + en 的缩写，如「云 yún」。j/q/x 后的 ün 写作 un。
exp.en: ün is shorthand for ü + en, as in 云 (yún). After j/q/x, ün is written un.

q.zh: 英语单词 sun 的 un 音，最接近下列哪个中文韵母？
q.en: The 'un' sound in 'sun' is closest to which Chinese final?

exp.zh: 鼻韵母 an 像英语 sun 的 un，如「安 ān」。
exp.en: The final an is like 'un' in 'sun', as in 安 (ān).

q.zh: 英语单词 hen 的 en 音，最接近下列哪个中文韵母？
q.en: The 'en' sound in 'hen' is closest to which Chinese final?

exp.zh: 鼻韵母 en 像英语 hen 的 en，如「恩 ēn」。
exp.en: The final en is like 'en' in 'hen', as in 恩 (ēn).

q.zh: 英语单词 seen 的 een 音，最接近下列哪个中文韵母？
q.en: The 'een' sound in 'seen' is closest to which Chinese final?

exp.zh: 鼻韵母 in 像英语 seen 的 een，如「新 xīn」。
exp.en: The final in is like 'een' in 'seen', as in 新 (xīn).

q.zh: 英语单词 song 的 ong 音，最接近下列哪个中文韵母？
q.en: The 'ong' sound in 'song' is closest to which Chinese final?

exp.zh: 鼻韵母 ong 像英语 song 的 ong，如「红 hóng」。
exp.en: The final ong is like 'ong' in 'song', as in 红 (hóng).

q.zh: 鼻韵母 ang 的发音是？
q.en: How is the final ang pronounced?

exp.zh: ang = a + ng，如「长 cháng」。
exp.en: ang = a + ng, as in 长 (cháng).

q.zh: 鼻韵母 eng 的发音是？
q.en: How is the final eng pronounced?

exp.zh: eng = e + ng，如「朋 péng」。
exp.en: eng = e + ng, as in 朋 (péng).

q.zh: 鼻韵母 ing 的发音是？
q.en: How is the final ing pronounced?

exp.zh: ing = i + ng，如「明 míng」。
exp.en: ing = i + ng, as in 明 (míng).

q.zh: an 和 ang 的主要区别是？
q.en: What is the main difference between an and ang?

zh: an 是前鼻音，ang 是后鼻音
an 是后鼻音，ang 是前鼻音
en: an is a front nasal, ang is a back nasal
an is a back nasal, ang is a front nasal

exp.zh: an 是前鼻音（舌尖抵齿龈），ang 是后鼻音（舌根抬起）。
exp.en: an is a front nasal (tongue tip at the ridge), ang is a back nasal (back of tongue raised).

q.zh: en 和 eng 的主要区别是？
q.en: What is the main difference between en and eng?

zh: en 是后鼻音，eng 是前鼻音
en 是前鼻音，eng 是后鼻音
en: en is a back nasal, eng is a front nasal
en is a front nasal, eng is a back nasal

exp.zh: en 是前鼻音，eng 是后鼻音。
exp.en: en is a front nasal; eng is a back nasal.

q.zh: in 和 ing 的主要区别是？
q.en: What is the main difference between in and ing?

zh: in 是前鼻音，ing 是后鼻音
in 是后鼻音，ing 是前鼻音
en: in is a front nasal, ing is a back nasal
in is a back nasal, ing is a front nasal

exp.zh: in 是前鼻音，ing 是后鼻音。
exp.en: in is a front nasal; ing is a back nasal.

q.en: Which of the following is a front nasal final?

exp.zh: an 是前鼻韵母；ang、eng、ing 都是后鼻韵母。
exp.en: an is a front nasal; ang, eng, ing are all back nasals.

q.en: Which of the following is a back nasal final?

exp.zh: ang 是后鼻韵母；an、en、in 都是前鼻韵母。
exp.en: ang is a back nasal; an, en, in are all front nasals.

q.en: Which final is in 「天 tiān」?

exp.zh: 天 tiān 中的韵母是 ian（i + an）。
exp.en: 天 tiān uses the final ian (i + an).

q.en: Which final is in 「家 jiā」?

exp.zh: 家 jiā 中的韵母是 ia（i + a）。
exp.en: 家 jiā uses the final ia (i + a).

q.en: Which final is in 「花 huā」?

exp.zh: 花 huā 中的韵母是 ua（u + a）。
exp.en: 花 huā uses the final ua (u + a).

q.en: Which final is in 「说 shuō」?

exp.zh: 说 shuō 中的韵母是 uo（u + o）。
exp.en: 说 shuō uses the final uo (u + o).

q.en: Which final is in 「圆 yuán」?

exp.zh: 圆 yuán 中的韵母是 üan（ü + an）。y + üan 写作 yuan。
exp.en: 圆 yuán uses the final üan (ü + an). y + üan is written yuan.

q.en: Which final is in 「走 zǒu」?

exp.zh: 走 zǒu 中的韵母是 ou。
exp.en: 走 zǒu uses the final ou.

q.en: Which final is in 「写 xiě」?

exp.zh: 写 xiě 中的韵母是 ie。
exp.en: 写 xiě uses the final ie.

q.en: Which final is in 「月 yuè」?

exp.zh: 月 yuè 中的韵母是 üe（ü + e）。y + üe 写作 yue。
exp.en: 月 yuè uses the final üe (ü + e). y + üe is written yue.

q.en: Which final is in 「爱 ài」?

exp.zh: 爱 ài 中的韵母是 ai。
exp.en: 爱 ài uses the final ai.

q.en: Which final is in 「对 duì」?

exp.zh: 对 duì 中的韵母是 ui（u + e + i 的缩写）。
exp.en: 对 duì uses the final ui (short for u + e + i).

papers.titleZh: 试卷 3：声调与拼读

q.en: What tone does 「妈 mā」 use?

exp.zh: mā 是第一声（阴平），声调符号为「ˉ」，音高平直。
exp.en: mā is the first tone (high level), marked with ˉ — a flat high pitch.

q.en: What tone does 「麻 má」 use?

exp.zh: má 是第二声（阳平），声调符号为「ˊ」，音高上升。
exp.en: má is the second tone (rising), marked with ˊ — the pitch rises.

q.en: What tone does 「马 mǎ」 use?

exp.zh: mǎ 是第三声（上声），声调符号为「ˇ」，音高先降后升。
exp.en: mǎ is the third tone (dipping), marked with ˇ — the pitch falls then rises.

q.en: What tone does 「骂 mà」 use?

exp.zh: mà 是第四声（去声），声调符号为「ˋ」，音高从高到低。
exp.en: mà is the fourth tone (falling), marked with ˋ — the pitch falls from high to low.

q.zh: 「妈麻马骂」四字的声调依次是？
q.en: What is the tone order of 「妈麻马骂」?

exp.zh: 妈 mā(1)、麻 má(2)、马 mǎ(3)、骂 mà(4)，是经典的声调练习句。
exp.en: 妈 mā(1), 麻 má(2), 马 mǎ(3), 骂 mà(4) — the classic tone practice set.

q.zh: 拼音数字标记法中，mā 写作？
q.en: In numbered pinyin, how is mā written?

exp.zh: 第一声用数字 1 标记：ma1 = mā。
exp.en: The first tone uses the number 1: ma1 = mā.

q.zh: 拼音数字标记法中，mǎ 写作？
q.en: In numbered pinyin, how is mǎ written?

exp.zh: 第三声用数字 3 标记：ma3 = mǎ。
exp.en: The third tone uses the number 3: ma3 = mǎ.

q.zh: 拼音数字标记法中，ma4 对应哪个字？
q.en: In numbered pinyin, which character does ma4 correspond to?

exp.zh: ma4 = mà = 骂（第四声）。
exp.en: ma4 = mà = 骂 (fourth tone).

q.en: Which tone mark represents the first tone?

exp.zh: 第一声符号是「ˉ」（平）。
exp.en: The first tone is marked with ˉ (flat).

q.en: Which tone mark represents the fourth tone?

exp.zh: 第四声符号是「ˋ」（下降）。
exp.en: The fourth tone is marked with ˋ (falling).

q.en: How does 「一 yī」 change before a fourth tone?

exp.zh: 一在第四声前变第二声：一个 yí ge、一次 yí cì。
exp.en: 一 becomes second tone before a fourth tone: 一个 yí ge, 一次 yí cì.

q.zh: 「一 yī」在第一、二、三声前会变成？
q.en: How does 「一 yī」 change before a first, second, or third tone?

exp.zh: 一在第一、二、三声前变第四声：一天 yì tiān、一年 yì nián、一起 yì qǐ。
exp.en: 一 becomes fourth tone before first/second/third tones: 一天 yì tiān, 一年 yì nián, 一起 yì qǐ.

q.zh: 「一个 yī ge」中「一」实际读作？
q.en: How is 「一」 actually pronounced in 「一个 yī ge」?

exp.zh: 个 ge 是轻声/第四声，前面的一变第二声 yí。
exp.en: 个 is neutral/fourth tone, so 一 becomes second tone yí.

q.zh: 「一天 yī tiān」中「一」实际读作？
q.en: How is 「一」 actually pronounced in 「一天 yī tiān」?

exp.zh: 天 tiān 是第一声，前面的一变第四声 yì。
exp.en: 天 tiān is first tone, so 一 becomes fourth tone yì.

q.en: How does 「不 bù」 change before a fourth tone?

exp.zh: 不在第四声前变第二声：不是 bú shì、不要 bú yào。
exp.en: 不 becomes second tone before a fourth tone: 不是 bú shì, 不要 bú yào.

q.zh: 「不是 bù shì」中「不」实际读作？
q.en: How is 「不」 actually pronounced in 「不是 bù shì」?

exp.zh: 是 shì 是第四声，前面的不变第二声 bú。
exp.en: 是 shì is fourth tone, so 不 becomes second tone bú.

q.zh: 「不好 bù hǎo」中「不」实际读作？
q.en: How is 「不」 actually pronounced in 「不好 bù hǎo」?

exp.zh: 好 hǎo 是第三声（非第四声），不保持第四声 bù。
exp.en: 好 hǎo is third tone (not fourth), so 不 stays fourth tone bù.

q.zh: 两个第三声连读时，第一个变成？
q.en: When two third tones are read together, the first becomes what tone?

exp.zh: 三声连读变调：第一个第三声变第二声。如「你好 nǐ hǎo」实际读 ní hǎo。
exp.en: Third-tone sandhi: the first third tone becomes second tone. 你好 nǐ hǎo → ní hǎo.

q.en: How is 「你好 nǐ hǎo」 actually pronounced?

exp.zh: 两个第三声连读，前一个变第二声：ní hǎo。
exp.en: Two third tones in a row → the first becomes second: ní hǎo.

q.en: How is 「很好 hěn hǎo」 actually pronounced?

exp.zh: 两个第三声连读，前一个变第二声：hén hǎo。
exp.en: Two third tones → the first becomes second: hén hǎo.

q.zh: 「我很好 wǒ hěn hǎo」实际读作？
q.en: How is 「我很好 wǒ hěn hǎo」 actually pronounced?

exp.zh: 三个第三声连读时，前两个都变第二声：wó hén hǎo。
exp.en: With three third tones in a row, the first two become second: wó hén hǎo.

q.zh: 下列哪句包含三声连读变调？
q.en: Which phrase involves third-tone sandhi?

exp.zh: 「很好」是两个第三声连读，需要变调。
exp.en: 很好 consists of two third tones and requires sandhi.

q.zh: 第三声在句末或单独出现时的调值接近？
q.en: A third tone at the end of a sentence or in isolation is closest to which pitch shape?

en: Dipping (falls then rises — full third tone)

exp.zh: 全三声为「降升调」（214），句末/单独时读完整。
exp.en: The full third tone is dipping (214) and is read fully at the end of a sentence or in isolation.

q.zh: 第三声在第一、二、四声前通常只读？
q.en: A third tone before a first, second, or fourth tone usually reduces to what?

en: Only the falling part (half third tone)

exp.zh: 半三声只读下降部分：如「你们 nǐmen」中的 nǐ 只读低降。
exp.en: A half third tone reads only the falling part: nǐ in 你们 nǐmen is a low falling tone.

q.en: How is the neutral tone marked in pinyin?

exp.zh: 轻声通常不标声调符号；数字标记法中写 ma5 或不标。
exp.en: Neutral tone is usually written without a tone mark; in numbered pinyin, ma5 or no number.

q.en: In 「妈妈 māma」, how is the second 「妈」 pronounced?

exp.zh: 叠词中第二个字通常读轻声：māma。
exp.en: In reduplicated words, the second syllable is usually neutral: māma.

q.en: In 「谢谢 xièxie」, how is the second 「谢」 pronounced?

exp.zh: 叠词中第二个字读轻声：xièxie。
exp.en: In reduplicated words, the second syllable is neutral: xièxie.

q.en: In 「东西 dōngxi」, how is 「西」 pronounced?

exp.zh: 东西（thing）读 dōngxi，「西」为轻声；东西（east and west）则读 dōngxī。
exp.en: 东西 (thing) is dōngxi, with neutral 西; 东西 (east and west) is dōngxī.

q.en: Which word contains a neutral tone?

exp.zh: 「子 zi」在桌子中读轻声。
exp.en: 子 zi is neutral in 桌子.

q.en: What is the pinyin of 「你好」?

exp.zh: 标调写作 nǐ hǎo（实际读 ní hǎo）。
exp.en: Written as nǐ hǎo (actually pronounced ní hǎo).

q.en: What is the pinyin of 「中国」?

exp.zh: 中 zhōng（第一声）+ 国 guó（第二声）。
exp.en: 中 zhōng (first tone) + 国 guó (second tone).

q.en: What is the pinyin of 「老师」?

exp.zh: 老 lǎo（第三声）+ 师 shī（第一声）。
exp.en: 老 lǎo (third tone) + 师 shī (first tone).

q.en: What is the pinyin of 「朋友」?

exp.zh: 朋 péng（第二声）+ 友 yǒu（第三声）。
exp.en: 朋 péng (second tone) + 友 yǒu (third tone).

q.en: What is the pinyin of 「谢谢」?

exp.zh: 第一个谢读 xiè（第四声），第二个读轻声 xie。
exp.en: The first 谢 is xiè (fourth tone); the second is neutral xie.

q.en: What is the pinyin of 「再见」?

exp.zh: 再 zài（第四声）+ 见 jiàn（第四声）。
exp.en: 再 zài (fourth tone) + 见 jiàn (fourth tone).

q.en: What is the pinyin of 「今天」?

exp.zh: 今 jīn（第一声）+ 天 tiān（第一声）。
exp.en: 今 jīn (first tone) + 天 tiān (first tone).

q.en: What is the pinyin of 「吃饭」?

exp.zh: 吃 chī（第一声）+ 饭 fàn（第四声）。
exp.en: 吃 chī (first tone) + 饭 fàn (fourth tone).

q.en: What is the standard pinyin (with tone marks) of 「很好」?

exp.zh: 标调写作 hěn hǎo（原调），实际读音为 hén hǎo（变调）。
exp.en: Written as hěn hǎo (underlying tones); actually pronounced hén hǎo (sandhi).

q.en: In 「我不知道」, how is 「不」 actually pronounced?

exp.zh: 知道 zhīdào 的「知」是第一声（非第四声），不保持第四声 bù。
exp.en: 知 in 知道 zhīdào is first tone (not fourth), so 不 stays bù.

papers.titleZh: 试卷 4：基础汉字

q.zh: 数字 1 对应的汉字是？
q.en: Which character means the number 1?

exp.zh: 一 表示数字 1，是最简单的汉字之一，只有 1 画。
exp.en: 一 means 'one' — one of the simplest Chinese characters, with only 1 stroke.

q.zh: 数字 2 对应的汉字是？
q.en: Which character means the number 2?

exp.zh: 二 表示数字 2，2 画。
exp.en: 二 means 'two', with 2 strokes.

q.zh: 数字 3 对应的汉字是？
q.en: Which character means the number 3?

exp.zh: 三 表示数字 3，3 画。
exp.en: 三 means 'three', with 3 strokes.

q.zh: 数字 4 对应的汉字是？
q.en: Which character means the number 4?

exp.zh: 四 表示数字 4，5 画。
exp.en: 四 means 'four', with 5 strokes.

q.zh: 数字 5 对应的汉字是？
q.en: Which character means the number 5?

exp.zh: 五 表示数字 5，4 画。
exp.en: 五 means 'five', with 4 strokes.

q.zh: 数字 6 对应的汉字是？
q.en: Which character means the number 6?

exp.zh: 六 表示数字 6，4 画。
exp.en: 六 means 'six', with 4 strokes.

q.zh: 数字 7 对应的汉字是？
q.en: Which character means the number 7?

exp.zh: 七 表示数字 7，2 画。
exp.en: 七 means 'seven', with 2 strokes.

q.zh: 数字 8 对应的汉字是？
q.en: Which character means the number 8?

exp.zh: 八 表示数字 8，2 画。
exp.en: 八 means 'eight', with 2 strokes.

q.zh: 数字 9 对应的汉字是？
q.en: Which character means the number 9?

exp.zh: 九 表示数字 9，2 画。
exp.en: 九 means 'nine', with 2 strokes.

q.zh: 数字 10 对应的汉字是？
q.en: Which character means the number 10?

exp.zh: 十 表示数字 10，2 画。
exp.en: 十 means 'ten', with 2 strokes.

q.en: Which character means 'sun'?

exp.zh: 日 表示太阳、日子，象形字，4 画。
exp.en: 日 means 'sun' or 'day'; it is a pictograph with 4 strokes.

q.en: Which character means 'moon'?

exp.zh: 月 表示月亮、月份，象形字，4 画。
exp.en: 月 means 'moon' or 'month'; it is a pictograph with 4 strokes.

q.en: Which character means 'mountain'?

exp.zh: 山 表示山，象形字，3 画。
exp.en: 山 means 'mountain'; it is a pictograph with 3 strokes.

q.en: Which character means 'water'?

exp.zh: 水 表示水，象形字，4 画。
exp.en: 水 means 'water'; it is a pictograph with 4 strokes.

q.en: Which character means 'fire'?

exp.zh: 火 表示火，象形字，4 画。
exp.en: 火 means 'fire'; it is a pictograph with 4 strokes.

q.en: Which character means 'tree / wood'?

exp.zh: 木 表示树、木头，象形字，4 画。
exp.en: 木 means 'tree / wood'; it is a pictograph with 4 strokes.

q.en: Which character means 'earth / soil'?

exp.zh: 土 表示土、土地，象形字，3 画。
exp.en: 土 means 'earth / soil'; it is a pictograph with 3 strokes.

q.en: Which character means 'person'?

exp.zh: 人 表示人，象形字，2 画。
exp.en: 人 means 'person'; it is a pictograph with 2 strokes.

q.en: Which character means 'mouth'?

exp.zh: 口 表示嘴、开口，象形字，3 画。
exp.en: 口 means 'mouth'; it is a pictograph with 3 strokes.

q.en: Which character means 'hand'?

exp.zh: 手 表示手，象形字，4 画。
exp.en: 手 means 'hand'; it is a pictograph with 4 strokes.

q.en: Which character means 'foot / leg'?

exp.zh: 足 表示脚、腿，象形字，7 画。
exp.en: 足 means 'foot / leg'; it is a pictograph with 7 strokes.

q.en: Which character means 'I / me'?

exp.zh: 我 是第一人称代词「我」。
exp.en: 我 is the first-person pronoun 'I / me'.

q.en: How many strokes does 「一」 have?

exp.zh: 一 只有 1 画：一横。
exp.en: 一 has 1 stroke: a single horizontal line.

q.en: How many strokes does 「三」 have?

exp.zh: 三 有 3 画：三横。
exp.en: 三 has 3 strokes: three horizontal lines.

q.en: How many strokes does 「日」 have?

exp.zh: 日 有 4 画：竖、横折、横、横。
exp.en: 日 has 4 strokes: vertical, horizontal-turn, horizontal, horizontal.

q.en: How many strokes does 「山」 have?

exp.zh: 山 有 3 画：竖、竖折、竖。
exp.en: 山 has 3 strokes.

q.en: How many strokes does 「水」 have?

exp.zh: 水 有 4 画。
exp.en: 水 has 4 strokes.

q.en: How many strokes does 「人」 have?

exp.zh: 人 有 2 画：撇、捺。
exp.en: 人 has 2 strokes: left-falling and right-falling.

q.en: What is the antonym of 「大」 (big)?

exp.zh: 大 ↔ 小：尺寸的对立。
exp.en: 大 (big) ↔ 小 (small).

q.en: What is the antonym of 「小」 (small)?

exp.zh: 小 ↔ 大。
exp.en: 小 (small) ↔ 大 (big).

q.en: What is the antonym of 「上」 (up)?

exp.zh: 上 ↔ 下：方位的对立。
exp.en: 上 (up) ↔ 下 (down).

q.en: What is the antonym of 「下」 (down)?

exp.zh: 下 ↔ 上。
exp.en: 下 (down) ↔ 上 (up).

q.en: What is the antonym of 「左」 (left)?

exp.zh: 左 ↔ 右。
exp.en: 左 (left) ↔ 右 (right).

q.en: What is the antonym of 「右」 (right)?

exp.zh: 右 ↔ 左。
exp.en: 右 (right) ↔ 左 (left).

q.en: What is the antonym of 「多」 (many)?

exp.zh: 多 ↔ 少：数量的对立。
exp.en: 多 (many) ↔ 少 (few).

q.en: What is the antonym of 「少」 (few)?

exp.zh: 少 ↔ 多。
exp.en: 少 (few) ↔ 多 (many).

q.en: What does 「上」 mean?

exp.zh: 上 表示上面、向上，如「上面 shàngmiàn」。
exp.en: 上 means 'up / above', as in 上面 shàngmiàn.

q.en: What does 「下」 mean?

exp.zh: 下 表示下面、向下，如「下面 xiàmiàn」。
exp.en: 下 means 'down / below', as in 下面 xiàmiàn.

q.en: What does 「左」 mean?

exp.zh: 左 表示左边，如「左边 zuǒbiān」。
exp.en: 左 means 'left', as in 左边 zuǒbiān.

q.en: What does 「右」 mean?

exp.zh: 右 表示右边，如「右边 yòubiān」。
exp.en: 右 means 'right', as in 右边 yòubiān.

papers.titleZh: 试卷 5：中餐

q.en: What is the Chinese word for 'dumpling'?

exp.zh: 饺子（jiǎozi）是中国北方最具代表性的面食，形如元宝。
exp.en: 饺子 (jiǎozi) is the most iconic northern Chinese dumpling, shaped like a gold ingot.

q.en: What is the Chinese word for 'steamed bun'?

exp.zh: 包子（bāozi）是带馅的蒸制面食，皮厚馅足。
exp.en: 包子 (bāozi) is a steamed bun with filling and a thicker wrapper.

q.en: What is the Chinese word for 'noodles'?

exp.zh: 面条（miàntiáo）是中国最常见的主食之一，南北皆有。
exp.en: 面条 (miàntiáo) is one of the most common staples across China.

q.en: What is the Chinese word for 'cooked rice'?

exp.zh: 米饭（mǐfàn）是南方人的主食，蒸熟的白米饭。
exp.en: 米饭 (mǐfàn) is steamed white rice, the staple food of southern China.

q.en: What is the Chinese word for 'fried rice'?

exp.zh: 炒饭（chǎofàn）是把米饭与鸡蛋、蔬菜等一起炒制的家常菜。
exp.en: 炒饭 (chǎofàn) is rice stir-fried with egg, vegetables, etc.

q.en: What is the Chinese name for 'Peking duck'?

exp.zh: 北京烤鸭（Běijīng kǎoyā）是北京名菜，皮脆肉嫩，配薄饼和甜面酱。
exp.en: 北京烤鸭 (Peking duck) is a Beijing specialty — crispy skin, tender meat, served with pancakes and sweet bean sauce.

q.en: What is the Chinese word for 'hot pot'?

exp.zh: 火锅（huǒguō）是在沸腾汤底中涮煮食材的饮食方式，尤其在四川、重庆风行。
exp.en: 火锅 (huǒguō) is a style of eating where ingredients are cooked in a boiling broth, especially popular in Sichuan and Chongqing.

q.en: What is the Chinese word for 'malatang' (spicy hot-pot soup)?

exp.zh: 麻辣烫（málàtàng）是把选好的食材放入麻辣汤底中烫煮的街头小吃。
exp.en: 麻辣烫 (málàtàng) is a street food where chosen ingredients are boiled in a spicy, numbing broth.

q.en: What is the Chinese word for 'soup dumpling'?

exp.zh: 小笼包（xiǎolóngbāo）是上海的招牌点心，皮薄多汁，里面包着热汤。
exp.en: 小笼包 (xiǎolóngbāo) is a signature Shanghai dim sum — thin skin, juicy, filled with hot soup.

q.en: What is the Chinese word for 'spring roll'?

exp.zh: 春卷（chūnjuǎn）是油炸的薄皮卷，常在春节食用。
exp.en: 春卷 (chūnjuǎn) is a deep-fried thin wrapper roll, often eaten during Spring Festival.

q.en: What is the Chinese word for 'mooncake'?

exp.zh: 月饼（yuèbǐng）是中秋节的传统点心，圆形代表团圆。
exp.en: 月饼 (yuèbǐng) is a mooncake, a traditional Mid-Autumn Festival pastry; its round shape symbolizes reunion.

q.en: What is the Chinese word for 'zongzi' (glutinous rice dumpling)?

exp.zh: 粽子（zòngzi）用竹叶包裹糯米蒸制，是端午节的传统食物。
exp.en: 粽子 (zòngzi) is glutinous rice wrapped in bamboo leaves and steamed — traditional for the Dragon Boat Festival.

q.en: What is the Chinese word for 'tangyuan' (glutinous rice balls)?

exp.zh: 汤圆（tāngyuán）是元宵节吃的甜糯米圆子，寓意团圆。
exp.en: 汤圆 (tāngyuán) are sweet glutinous rice balls eaten at the Lantern Festival, symbolizing reunion.

q.en: What is the Chinese word for 'soy milk'?

exp.zh: 豆浆（dòujiāng）是黄豆磨制的中式早餐饮品。
exp.en: 豆浆 (dòujiāng) is a soy milk drink, a classic Chinese breakfast item.

q.en: What is the Chinese word for 'fried dough stick'?

exp.zh: 油条（yóutiáo）是长条形的油炸面食，常配豆浆当早餐。
exp.en: 油条 (yóutiáo) is a long, deep-fried dough stick, often paired with soy milk for breakfast.

q.en: What is the Chinese word for 'congee' (rice porridge)?

exp.zh: 粥（zhōu）是把米煮烂的稀饭，常配小菜食用。
exp.en: 粥 (zhōu) is rice porridge, often served with side dishes.

q.en: What is the Chinese word for 'Mapo tofu'?

exp.zh: 麻婆豆腐（mápó dòufu）是四川名菜，麻辣鲜香，豆腐嫩滑。
exp.en: 麻婆豆腐 (Mapo tofu) is a Sichuan dish — numbing, spicy, and savory with silky tofu.

q.en: What is the Chinese word for 'Kung Pao chicken'?

exp.zh: 宫保鸡丁（gōngbǎo jīdīng）是川菜名品，鸡丁配花生和干辣椒。
exp.en: 宫保鸡丁 (Kung Pao chicken) is a Sichuan dish — diced chicken with peanuts and dried chilies.

q.en: What is the Chinese word for 'sweet and sour pork'?

exp.zh: 糖醋里脊（tángcù lǐjǐ）是酸甜可口的炸猪肉条。
exp.en: 糖醋里脊 (sweet and sour pork) is crispy pork strips in a sweet-and-sour sauce.

q.en: What is the Chinese word for 'wonton'?

exp.zh: 馄饨（húntun）是包着肉馅的薄皮汤饺，常配清汤食用。
exp.en: 馄饨 (húntun) is a thin-skinned meat dumpling served in soup.

q.en: What is the traditional food for the Mid-Autumn Festival?

exp.zh: 中秋节吃月饼，象征家人团圆。
exp.en: Mooncakes are eaten at the Mid-Autumn Festival, symbolizing family reunion.

q.en: What is the traditional food for the Dragon Boat Festival?

exp.zh: 端午节吃粽子，纪念诗人屈原。
exp.en: Zongzi are eaten at the Dragon Boat Festival in memory of the poet Qu Yuan.

q.en: What is the traditional food for the Lantern Festival?

exp.zh: 元宵节吃汤圆（元宵），寓意全家团圆。
exp.en: Tangyuan are eaten at the Lantern Festival, symbolizing reunion.

q.zh: 春节北方常吃的传统食物是？
q.en: What is the traditional food for Spring Festival in northern China?

exp.zh: 北方春节吃饺子，形状如元宝，寓意招财进宝。
exp.en: Northern China eats dumplings at Spring Festival; their shape resembles gold ingots, symbolizing wealth.

q.en: What is the traditional food for the Laba Festival?

exp.zh: 腊八节喝腊八粥，用八种以上米豆干果熬成。
exp.en: Laba porridge is eaten at the Laba Festival, made with eight or more grains, beans, and dried fruits.

papers.titleZh: 试卷 1：基础句型
papers.titleEn: Paper 1: Basic Sentence Patterns (基础句型)

q.en: What is the pinyin of 「我是学生」?

exp.zh: 我是学生 wǒ shì xuésheng（「生」在「学生」中读轻声 sheng）。
exp.en: 我是学生 is wǒ shì xuésheng (生 is neutral in 学生).

q.en: What does 「是」 mean?

exp.zh: 是（shì）是判断动词，相当于英语的 be 动词。
exp.en: 是 (shì) is the copula, equivalent to English 'to be'.

q.en: How is 「不是」 pronounced in 「我不是学生」?

exp.zh: 是 shì 是第四声，所以「不」变第二声 bú。
exp.en: 是 shì is fourth tone, so 不 becomes second tone: bú shì.

q.en: What does 「我有两个哥哥」 mean?

exp.zh: 有（yǒu）= 有；哥哥（gēge）= 哥哥（年长）。
exp.en: 有 (yǒu) = to have; 哥哥 (gēge) = older brother.

q.en: What does 「他在学校」 mean?

exp.zh: 在（zài）+ 地点，表示在某处。
exp.en: 在 (zài) + place marks location.

q.en: What is the function of 「的」 in 「我的书」?

exp.zh: 的（de）连接名词，表示所有关系，相当于英语的 's。
exp.en: 的 (de) links nouns to show possession, like 's in English.

q.en: What does 「了」 in 「他去了学校」 express?

exp.zh: 了（le）作动态助词，表示动作完成：去了 = went。
exp.en: 了 (le) as an aspect marker shows completion: 去了 = went.

q.en: What does 「过」 in 「我吃过饭了」 express?

exp.zh: 过（guò）表示曾经经历：吃过 = have eaten before。
exp.en: 过 (guò) marks past experience: 吃过 = have eaten before.

q.en: What does 「很」 do in 「他很高」?

zh: 仅连接形容词，无强语义

exp.zh: 在形容词谓语句中，很 常用于连接主语和形容词，不一定强调「非常」。
exp.en: In adjective predicates, 很 typically just links subject and adjective and may not mean 'very'.

q.en: What is the pinyin of 「他是中国人」?

exp.zh: 他 tā + 是 shì + 中国人 zhōngguórén。
exp.en: 他 tā + 是 shì + 中国人 zhōngguórén.

papers.titleZh: 试卷 2：疑问句

q.en: What kind of question is 「你好吗？」?

exp.zh: 吗（ma）放在句末，构成是非问句。
exp.en: 吗 (ma) at the end forms a yes/no question.

q.en: What does 「谁」 mean in 「你是谁？」?

exp.zh: 谁（shéi）是疑问代词，意为「谁」。
exp.en: 谁 (shéi) means 'who'.

q.en: What does 「什么」 mean in 「这是什么？」?

exp.zh: 什么（shénme）意为「什么」。
exp.en: 什么 (shénme) means 'what'.

q.en: What does 「哪里」 mean in 「你在哪里？」?

exp.zh: 哪里（nǎlǐ）意为「哪里」。
exp.en: 哪里 (nǎlǐ) means 'where'.

q.en: What does 「怎么」 mean in 「你怎么去？」?

exp.zh: 怎么（zěnme）意为「怎么、如何」。
exp.en: 怎么 (zěnme) means 'how'.

q.zh: 「你为什么迟到？」中「为什么」的意思是？
q.en: What does 「为什么」 mean in 「你为什么迟到？」?

exp.zh: 为什么（wèishénme）意为「为什么」。
exp.en: 为什么 (wèishénme) means 'why'.

q.en: What kind of question is 「他去不去？」?

exp.zh: 正反问：动词肯定 + 否定 并列，如「去不去」。
exp.en: A-not-A question: verb in affirmative + negative, e.g. 去不去.

q.zh: 「你喝茶还是咖啡？」是哪种疑问句？
q.en: What kind of question is 「你喝茶还是咖啡？」?

exp.zh: 还是（háishì）连接两个选项，构成选择问。
exp.en: 还是 (háishì) connects two alternatives to form a choice question.

q.en: What does 「什么时候」 mean?

exp.zh: 什么时候（shénme shíhou）意为「什么时候」。
exp.en: 什么时候 (shénme shíhou) means 'when'.

q.en: What is a correct reply to 「你是老师吗？」?

exp.zh: 问句主语是「你」，回答用「我」：是，我是老师。
exp.en: The question uses 你; the reply switches to 我: 是，我是老师。

papers.titleZh: 试卷 3：量词

q.en: Which measure word goes with 「人」?

exp.zh: 个（gè）是最通用的量词，用于人、物品等。
exp.en: 个 (gè) is the most general measure word, used for people and objects.

q.en: In 「三本书」, what does 「本」 count?

exp.zh: 本（běn）常用于书、本子等有装订的长形物品。
exp.en: 本 (běn) is used for books and bound, long-shaped items.

q.en: In 「两只猫」, what does 「只」 count?

exp.zh: 只（zhī）常用于小动物、一对中的一只。
exp.en: 只 (zhī) is used for small animals or one of a pair.

q.en: In 「一张纸」, what does 「张」 count?

exp.zh: 张（zhāng）用于扁平的物品：纸、桌子、床、嘴。
exp.en: 张 (zhāng) is used for flat objects: paper, tables, beds, mouths.

q.en: In 「一条鱼」, what does 「条」 count?

exp.zh: 条（tiáo）用于细长形物体：鱼、蛇、路、领带、裤子。
exp.en: 条 (tiáo) is used for long, thin things: fish, snakes, roads, ties, trousers.

q.en: In 「一杯水」, what does 「杯」 count?

exp.zh: 杯（bēi）用于用杯装的饮品：一杯茶、一杯咖啡。
exp.en: 杯 (bēi) counts drinks in cups: a cup of tea, a cup of coffee.

q.en: In 「一件衣服」, what does 「件」 count?

exp.zh: 件（jiàn）用于上衣、外套，也用于事情：一件事。
exp.en: 件 (jiàn) is used for tops/jackets and for matters: 一件事.

q.en: In 「一辆车」, what does 「辆」 count?

exp.zh: 辆（liàng）用于车辆：一辆车、两辆自行车。
exp.en: 辆 (liàng) counts vehicles: one car, two bicycles.

q.en: In 「三朵花」, what does 「朵」 count?

exp.zh: 朵（duǒ）用于花朵、云朵。
exp.en: 朵 (duǒ) is used for flowers and clouds.

q.en: Which measure word is used for books?

exp.zh: 本（běn）是书、本子的量词。
exp.en: 本 (běn) is the measure word for books.

papers.titleZh: 试卷 4：时间与日期

q.en: What does 「今天」 mean?

exp.zh: 今天（jīntiān）= today。
exp.en: 今天 (jīntiān) = today.

q.en: What does 「明天」 mean?

exp.zh: 明天（míngtiān）= tomorrow。
exp.en: 明天 (míngtiān) = tomorrow.

q.en: What does 「昨天」 mean?

exp.zh: 昨天（zuótiān）= yesterday。
exp.en: 昨天 (zuótiān) = yesterday.

q.en: What does 「后天」 mean?

exp.zh: 后天（hòutiān）= the day after tomorrow。
exp.en: 后天 (hòutiān) = the day after tomorrow.

q.en: What is the pinyin of 「星期一」?

exp.zh: 星期一 xīngqīyī，星期读 qī（第一声）。
exp.en: 星期一 is xīngqīyī; 星期 is qī (first tone).

q.en: What is the pinyin of 「几点了？」?

exp.zh: 几（jǐ）第三声，表疑问；点（diǎn）表时间单位。
exp.en: 几 (jǐ, third tone) means 'how many'; 点 (diǎn) is the time unit.

q.en: What is the pinyin of 「现在三点」?

exp.zh: 现在 xiànzài（第四声 + 第四声）+ 三点 sān diǎn。
exp.en: 现在 xiànzài + 三点 sān diǎn.

q.en: What does 「中午」 mean?

exp.zh: 中午（zhōngwǔ）= noon。
exp.en: 中午 (zhōngwǔ) = noon.

q.en: What does 「晚上」 mean?

exp.zh: 晚上（wǎnshang）= evening。
exp.en: 晚上 (wǎnshang) = evening.

q.en: What is the pinyin of 「你什么时候来？」?

exp.zh: 什么时候 shénme shíhou（候为轻声），来 lái。
exp.en: 什么时候 shénme shíhou (候 is neutral), 来 lái.

papers.titleZh: 试卷 5：日常会话

q.en: What is the pinyin of 「你好」?

exp.zh: 你好 nǐ hǎo（实际读 ní hǎo，三声连读变调）。
exp.en: 你好 is nǐ hǎo (actually pronounced ní hǎo due to third-tone sandhi).

q.en: What is the pinyin of 「谢谢」?

exp.zh: 谢谢 xièxie（第二个「谢」读轻声）。
exp.en: 谢谢 is xièxie (second 谢 is neutral).

q.en: What is the pinyin of 「再见」?

exp.zh: 再见 zàijiàn（第四声 + 第四声）。
exp.en: 再见 is zàijiàn (fourth + fourth).

q.en: What does 「对不起」 mean?

exp.zh: 对不起（duìbuqǐ）意为「对不起」，礼貌道歉。
exp.en: 对不起 (duìbuqǐ) means 'sorry' — a polite apology.

q.en: What is the pinyin of 「请问」?

exp.zh: 请问 qǐngwèn（第三声 + 第四声）。
exp.en: 请问 is qǐngwèn (third + fourth).

q.en: What is the pinyin of 「我不知道」?

exp.zh: 我不知道 wǒ bù zhīdào（知是第一声，故「不」保持第四声）。
exp.en: 我不知道 is wǒ bù zhīdào (知 is first tone, so 不 stays fourth tone).

q.en: What does 「没关系」 mean?

exp.zh: 没关系（méi guānxi）意为「没关系、不要紧」。
exp.en: 没关系 (méi guānxi) means 'it's okay / never mind'.

q.en: What is the pinyin of 「我饿了」?

exp.zh: 我 wǒ + 饿 è（第四声）+ 了 le。
exp.en: 我 wǒ + 饿 è (fourth tone) + 了 le.

q.en: What is the pinyin of 「多少钱？」?

exp.zh: 多少 duōshǎo（第一声 + 第三声）+ 钱 qián。
exp.en: 多少 duōshǎo + 钱 qián.

q.zh: 「请问洗手间在哪里？」的拼音是？
q.en: What is the pinyin of 「请问洗手间在哪里？」?

exp.zh: 请问 qǐngwèn + 洗手间 xǐshǒujiān + 在哪里 zài nǎlǐ。
exp.en: 请问 qǐngwèn + 洗手间 xǐshǒujiān + 在哪里 zài nǎlǐ.

papers.titleZh: 试卷 1：动作的进行与完成
papers.titleEn: Paper 1: Progressive & Completed Actions (动作的进行与完成)

q.en: In 「他在吃饭」, what does 「在」 express?

exp.zh: 「在 + 动词」表示动作正在进行，相当于英语 be + V-ing。
exp.en: 在 + verb marks an action in progress, like 'be + V-ing'.

q.en: In 「我吃了饭」, what does 「了」 express?

exp.zh: 动词后的「了」表示动作已经完成。
exp.en: 了 after the verb marks a completed action.

q.en: In 「我去过北京」, what does 「过」 express?

exp.zh: 「过」表示曾经有过某种经历。
exp.en: 过 marks a past experience.

q.en: Which sentence means 'is doing (right now)'?

exp.zh: 「在 + 动词」表示动作正在进行：他在吃饭。
exp.en: 在 + verb expresses an ongoing action: 他在吃饭.

q.zh: 下列哪句表示「已经做完」？
q.en: Which sentence means 'has already done'?

exp.zh: 动词 + 了 表示动作已完成：我吃了饭。
exp.en: Verb + 了 marks completion: 我吃了饭.

q.zh: 下列哪句表示「曾经做过」？
q.en: Which sentence means 'has done before (experience)'?

exp.zh: 动词 + 过 表示过去经历：我去过北京。
exp.en: Verb + 过 marks past experience: 我去过北京.

q.en: What is the main difference between 「在」 and 「了」?

zh: 在 表进行，了 表完成
在 表完成，了 表进行
en: 在 marks progressive; 了 marks completion
在 marks completion; 了 marks progressive

exp.zh: 「在」表示正在进行，「了」表示已经完成。
exp.en: 在 marks an ongoing action; 了 marks a completed action.

q.en: What is the main difference between 「了」 and 「过」?

zh: 了 表经历，过 表完成
了 表完成，过 表经历
en: 了 marks experience; 过 marks completion
了 marks completion; 过 marks experience

exp.zh: 「了」强调动作完成，「过」强调曾经有过某种经历。
exp.en: 了 emphasizes completion; 过 emphasizes past experience.

q.en: What does 「他正在睡觉」 mean?

exp.zh: 「正在」是「在」的强调形式，表示正在进行。
exp.en: 正在 is the emphatic form of 在, meaning 'right now'.

q.en: What does 「我没吃过日本菜」 mean?

en: I have never eaten Japanese food
I want to eat Japanese food

exp.zh: 「没 + 动词 + 过」表示从未有过某经历。
exp.en: 没 + verb + 过 means 'have never done'.

papers.titleZh: 试卷 2：结果补语

q.en: What does 「吃完」 mean?

exp.zh: 完 作结果补语，表示动作完成到底：吃完 = eat up。
exp.en: 完 as a resultative complement means 'finish completely': 吃完 = eat up.

q.en: What does 「看完」 mean?

exp.zh: 看完 = finish watching (to the end)。
exp.en: 看完 = finish watching (to the end).

q.en: What does 「做好」 mean?

exp.zh: 好 作结果补语，表示完成或做得妥当：做好 = do well / finish。
exp.en: 好 as a resultative complement means 'do well / finish': 做好.

q.en: What does 「听懂」 mean?

exp.zh: 懂 作结果补语，表示听完后理解了：听懂 = understand。
exp.en: 懂 as a resultative complement means 'understand as a result of listening'.

q.en: What does 「看见」 mean?

exp.zh: 见 作结果补语，表示看的结果是看到了：看见 = see。
exp.en: 见 as a resultative complement marks the result of looking: 看见 = see.

q.en: What does 「找到」 mean?

exp.zh: 到 作结果补语，表示动作达到目标：找到 = find。
exp.en: 到 as a resultative complement marks achieving the goal: 找到 = find.

q.en: What is the structure of a resultative complement?

exp.zh: 结果补语：动词 + 结果补语（完、好、懂、见、到等），如吃完、做好。
exp.en: Resultative complement: verb + result (完, 好, 懂, 见, 到, etc.), e.g. 吃完, 做好.

q.en: What does 「我吃完了饭」 mean?

exp.zh: 吃完 + 了 = 已经吃完。
exp.en: 吃完 + 了 = have finished eating.

q.en: What does 「他做完了作业」 mean?

en: He doesn't want to do homework

exp.zh: 做完 + 了 = 已经做完。
exp.en: 做完 + 了 = have finished doing.

q.zh: 结果补语的否定形式是？
q.en: What is the negative form of a resultative complement?

exp.zh: 结果补语的否定用「没」：没吃完、没看懂、没找到。
exp.en: The negative uses 没: 没吃完, 没看懂, 没找到.

papers.titleZh: 试卷 3：趋向补语

q.en: What does 「进来」 mean?

exp.zh: 进来 = come in（向说话人方向进来）。
exp.en: 进来 = come in (toward the speaker).

q.en: What does 「出去」 mean?

exp.zh: 出去 = go out（远离说话人方向出去）。
exp.en: 出去 = go out (away from the speaker).

q.en: What does 「起来」 mean?

exp.zh: 起来 = get up；也可引申为「开始」：笑起来（start laughing）。
exp.en: 起来 = get up; it can also mean 'start': 笑起来 (start laughing).

q.en: What does 「下去」 mean?

exp.zh: 下去 = go down；也可引申为「继续」：说下去（keep talking）。
exp.en: 下去 = go down; it can also mean 'continue': 说下去 (keep talking).

q.en: What does 「上来」 mean?

exp.zh: 上来 = come up（向说话人方向上来）。
exp.en: 上来 = come up (toward the speaker).

q.en: What does 「回去」 mean?

exp.zh: 回去 = go back（回到原来的地方）。
exp.en: 回去 = go back (to the original place).

q.en: What does 「走过来」 mean?

exp.zh: 过来 = come over（朝说话人方向走来）。
exp.en: 过来 = come over (toward the speaker).

q.zh: 趋向补语「来」和「去」的区别是？
q.en: What is the difference between 「来」 and 「去」 as directional complements?

zh: 来 远离说话人方向，去 朝说话人方向
来 朝说话人方向，去 远离说话人方向
en: 来 = away from the speaker; 去 = toward the speaker
来 = toward the speaker; 去 = away from the speaker

exp.zh: 来 表示朝说话人方向移动，去 表示远离说话人方向移动。
exp.en: 来 marks movement toward the speaker; 去 marks movement away.

q.en: What does 「他跑出去了」 mean?

exp.zh: 跑 + 出去 + 了 = ran out。
exp.en: 跑 + 出去 + 了 = ran out.

q.en: What does 「请进来」 mean?

exp.zh: 进来 = come in；请进来 = please come in。
exp.en: 进来 = come in; 请进来 = please come in.

papers.titleZh: 试卷 4：比较句

q.en: What does 「我比你高」 mean?

en: I am as tall as you
I don't know who is taller

exp.zh: A 比 B + 形容词 = A is more ... than B。
exp.en: A 比 B + adjective = A is more ... than B.

q.en: What does 「他没有我高」 mean?

en: He is not as tall as me
He is as tall as me

exp.zh: A 没有 B + 形容词 = A is not as ... as B。
exp.en: A 没有 B + adjective = A is not as ... as B.

q.en: What does 「我跟你一样高」 mean?

en: I am as tall as you
I am not as tall as you

exp.zh: A 跟 B 一样 + 形容词 = A is as ... as B。
exp.en: A 跟 B 一样 + adjective = A is as ... as B.

q.en: What is the structure of the 比 construction?

zh: A 比 B + 很 + 形容词
A 比 B 形容词
A 比 B + 形容词
A + 形容词 + 比 B
en: A 比 B + 很 + adjective

exp.zh: 基本结构：A 比 B + 形容词，如「我比你高」。
exp.en: Basic structure: A 比 B + adjective, e.g. 我比你高.

q.zh: 「A 比 B + 形容词」的意思是？
q.en: What does 'A 比 B + adjective' mean?

zh: A 比 B 更（形容词）
en: A and B are the same
A is not as good as B

exp.zh: A 比 B + 形容词 = A is more (adjective) than B。
exp.en: A 比 B + adjective = A is more (adjective) than B.

q.zh: 「A 没有 B + 形容词」的意思是？
q.en: What does 'A 没有 B + adjective' mean?

en: A and B are the same
A is not as (adjective) as B

exp.zh: A 没有 B + 形容词 = A is not as (adjective) as B。
exp.en: A 没有 B + adjective = A is not as (adjective) as B.

q.zh: 「A 跟 B 一样 + 形容词」的意思是？
q.en: What does 'A 跟 B 一样 + adjective' mean?

zh: A 和 B 一样（形容词）
en: A is not as good as B

exp.zh: A 跟 B 一样 + 形容词 = A is as (adjective) as B。
exp.en: A 跟 B 一样 + adjective = A is as (adjective) as B.

q.en: What does 「今天比昨天热」 mean?

en: Today and yesterday are equally hot

exp.zh: 今天比昨天 + 热 = 今天更热。
exp.en: 今天比昨天 + 热 = today is hotter.

q.en: What does 「这个比那个贵」 mean?

en: This is more expensive than that
That is more expensive than this

exp.zh: 这个比那个 + 贵 = 这个更贵。
exp.en: 这个比那个 + 贵 = this is more expensive.

q.zh: 比较句中不能说「我比你很高」，原因是？
q.en: Why can't we say 「我比你很高」 in a 比 sentence?

zh: 因为「比」后面不能加形容词
因为「很」不能和「比」同时用
en: Because 比 cannot be followed by an adjective
Because 很 cannot be used together with 比
Because 你 cannot be the object
Because 高 cannot be used in comparisons

exp.zh: 「比」字句中，形容词前一般不加「很」（「我比你高」即可）。
exp.en: In 比 sentences, 很 is not used before the adjective; 我比你高 is sufficient.

papers.titleZh: 试卷 5：能愿动词

q.en: What does 「能」 mainly mean?

exp.zh: 能 = can（有能力或可能性）：我能游泳。
exp.en: 能 = can (ability or possibility): 我能游泳.

q.en: What does 「会」 mainly mean?

exp.zh: 会 = can（学会的技能）：我会说中文。
exp.en: 会 = can (a learned skill): 我会说中文.

q.en: What does 「可以」 mainly mean?

exp.zh: 可以 = may（许可）：我可以进来吗？
exp.en: 可以 = may (permission): 我可以进来吗？

q.en: What does 「应该」 mainly mean?

exp.zh: 应该 = should：你应该休息。
exp.en: 应该 = should: 你应该休息.

q.en: What does 「必须」 mainly mean?

exp.zh: 必须 = must：你必须去。
exp.en: 必须 = must: 你必须去.

q.en: What is the main difference between 「能」 and 「会」?

zh: 能 表能力／条件，会 表学会的技能
能 表技能，会 表许可
en: 能 = ability/condition; 会 = a learned skill
能 = a skill; 会 = permission

exp.zh: 能 强调能力或客观条件，会 强调通过学learned的技能。
exp.en: 能 emphasizes ability/condition; 会 emphasizes a skill acquired through learning.

q.en: What does 「我可以进来吗？」 mean?

exp.zh: 可以 + 吗 = 请求许可。
exp.en: 可以 + 吗 = asking permission.

q.en: What does 「你应该休息」 mean?

exp.zh: 应该 = should（建议）。
exp.en: 应该 = should (suggestion).

q.en: What does 「你必须去」 mean?

exp.zh: 必须 = must（强制）。
exp.en: 必须 = must (obligation).

q.en: What does 「我会说中文」 mean?

exp.zh: 会 = 学会的技能：我会说中文。
exp.en: 会 = a learned skill: 我会说中文.

papers.titleZh: 试卷 1：基本母音与辅音 / 모음과 자음

q.en: How is the Korean letter 「ㅏ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: ㅏ 是韩语基本元音，读作 a，类似中文「啊」。
exp.en: ㅏ is a basic Korean vowel, pronounced 'a', like 'a' in 'father'.

q.en: How is the Korean letter 「ㅑ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: ㅑ 读作 ya，是 ㅏ 加上 y 音。
exp.en: ㅑ is pronounced 'ya', the ㅏ sound with a y-glide.

q.en: How is the Korean letter 「ㅓ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: ㅓ 读作 eo，类似英语 'uh'。
exp.en: ㅓ is pronounced 'eo', similar to 'uh' in English.

q.en: How is the Korean letter 「ㅕ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: ㅕ 读作 yeo，是 ㅓ 加上 y 音。
exp.en: ㅕ is pronounced 'yeo', the ㅓ sound with a y-glide.

q.en: How is the Korean letter 「ㅗ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: ㅗ 读作 o，类似英语 'o' in 'go'。
exp.en: ㅗ is pronounced 'o', like 'o' in 'go'.

q.en: How is the Korean letter 「ㅛ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: ㅛ 读作 yo，是 ㅗ 加上 y 音。
exp.en: ㅛ is pronounced 'yo', the ㅗ sound with a y-glide.

q.en: How is the Korean letter 「ㅜ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: ㅜ 读作 u，类似英语 'oo' in 'food'。
exp.en: ㅜ is pronounced 'u', like 'oo' in 'food'.

q.en: How is the Korean letter 「ㅠ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: ㅠ 读作 yu，是 ㅜ 加上 y 音。
exp.en: ㅠ is pronounced 'yu', the ㅜ sound with a y-glide.

q.en: How is the Korean letter 「ㅡ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: ㅡ 读作 eu，类似中文「思」的韵母，嘴唇扁平。
exp.en: ㅡ is pronounced 'eu', with flat, unrounded lips.

q.en: How is the Korean letter 「ㅣ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: ㅣ 读作 i，类似英语 'ee' in 'see'。
exp.en: ㅣ is pronounced 'i', like 'ee' in 'see'.

q.zh: 下列哪个元音的发音是「ya」？
q.en: Which vowel is pronounced 'ya'?

exp.zh: ㅑ 读作 ya。
exp.en: ㅑ is pronounced 'ya'.

q.zh: 下列哪个元音的发音是「yeo」？
q.en: Which vowel is pronounced 'yeo'?

exp.zh: ㅕ 读作 yeo。
exp.en: ㅕ is pronounced 'yeo'.

q.en: What is the main difference between 「ㅏ」 and 「ㅓ」?

zh: 嘴的张开方向（ㅏ 偏前，ㅓ 偏后）

exp.zh: ㅏ 是前元音，ㅓ 是后元音，发音时舌头位置不同。
exp.en: ㅏ is a front vowel; ㅓ is a back vowel. The tongue position differs.

q.en: What is the main difference between 「ㅗ」 and 「ㅜ」?

zh: 嘴唇形状（ㅗ 圆唇向前，ㅜ 圆唇内收）
en: Lip shape (ㅗ lips rounded outward, ㅜ inward)

exp.zh: ㅗ 嘴形向前突出，ㅜ 嘴唇圆而内收。
exp.en: ㅗ pushes the lips outward; ㅜ rounds them inward.

q.en: How is 「ㅑ」 derived from 「ㅏ」?

zh: 多加一笔表示 y 音
en: Adding a stroke to indicate y-glide

exp.zh: 韩语中 y 元音由基本元音「多加一笔」构成：ㅏ→ㅑ、ㅓ→ㅕ、ㅗ→ㅛ、ㅜ→ㅠ。
exp.en: Korean y-vowels add an extra stroke: ㅏ→ㅑ, ㅓ→ㅕ, ㅗ→ㅛ, ㅜ→ㅠ.

q.en: How is 「ㅛ」 derived from 「ㅗ」?

zh: 多加一笔表示 y 音
en: Adding a stroke to indicate y-glide

exp.zh: ㅗ 多一竖即为 ㅛ，表示 y 音。
exp.en: ㅗ with an extra vertical stroke becomes ㅛ, indicating a y-glide.

q.zh: 下列哪个元音发音时嘴唇最扁平？
q.en: Which vowel is pronounced with the flattest lips?

exp.zh: ㅡ 发音时嘴唇扁平，不圆唇。
exp.en: ㅡ is pronounced with flat, unrounded lips.

q.en: How is the Korean letter 「ㄱ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: ㄱ 在词首发 k，在词中/词尾发 g 的浊化音。
exp.en: ㄱ is 'k' at the start of a word and 'g' between/after vowels.

q.en: How is the Korean letter 「ㄴ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: ㄴ 读作 n，类似英语 'n'。
exp.en: ㄴ is pronounced 'n', like 'n' in English.

q.en: How is the Korean letter 「ㄷ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: ㄷ 在词首发 t，在词中/词尾发 d。
exp.en: ㄷ is 't' at the start of a word and 'd' between/after vowels.

q.en: How is the Korean letter 「ㄹ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: ㄹ 是弹舌音，介于 r 和 l 之间；词首接近 r，词尾接近 l。
exp.en: ㄹ is a flap, between r and l. It sounds like r at the start and l at the end.

q.en: How is the Korean letter 「ㅁ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: ㅁ 读作 m，是鼻音。
exp.en: ㅁ is pronounced 'm', a nasal sound.

q.en: How is the Korean letter 「ㅂ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: ㅂ 在词首发 p，在词中/词尾发 b。
exp.en: ㅂ is 'p' at the start of a word and 'b' between/after vowels.

q.en: How is the Korean letter 「ㅅ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: ㅅ 读作 s，但在 ㅣ 前读 sh。
exp.en: ㅅ is pronounced 's', but becomes 'sh' before ㅣ.

q.zh: 韩语字母「ㅇ」在音节开头时的作用？
q.en: What is the role of 「ㅇ」 at the start of a syllable?

exp.zh: ㅇ 在音节开头不发音，只作为占位符；在音节末尾发 ng。
exp.en: ㅇ is silent at the start of a syllable (a placeholder) and 'ng' at the end.

q.en: How is the Korean letter 「ㅈ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: ㅈ 读作 j，类似英语 'j' in 'jump'，但更轻。
exp.en: ㅈ is pronounced 'j', like 'j' in 'jump', but softer.

q.en: How is the Korean letter 「ㅊ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: ㅊ 是ㅈ 的送气音，读作 ch。
exp.en: ㅊ is the aspirated version of ㅈ, pronounced 'ch'.

q.en: How is the Korean letter 「ㅋ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: ㅋ 是ㄱ 的送气音，读作 k。
exp.en: ㅋ is the aspirated version of ㄱ, pronounced 'k'.

q.en: How is the Korean letter 「ㅌ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: ㅌ 是ㄷ 的送气音，读作 t。
exp.en: ㅌ is the aspirated version of ㄷ, pronounced 't'.

q.en: How is the Korean letter 「ㅍ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: ㅍ 是ㅂ 的送气音，读作 p。
exp.en: ㅍ is the aspirated version of ㅂ, pronounced 'p'.

q.en: How is the Korean letter 「ㅎ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: ㅎ 读作 h，类似英语 'h'。
exp.en: ㅎ is pronounced 'h', like 'h' in English.

q.en: What is the main difference between 「ㄱ」 and 「ㅋ」?

exp.zh: ㅋ 是ㄱ 的送气音。
exp.en: ㅋ is the aspirated counterpart of ㄱ.

q.en: What is the main difference between 「ㄷ」 and 「ㅌ」?

exp.zh: ㅌ 是ㄷ 的送气音。
exp.en: ㅌ is the aspirated counterpart of ㄷ.

q.en: What is the main difference between 「ㅂ」 and 「ㅍ」?

exp.zh: ㅍ 是ㅂ 的送气音。
exp.en: ㅍ is the aspirated counterpart of ㅂ.

q.en: What is the main difference between 「ㅈ」 and 「ㅊ」?

exp.zh: ㅊ 是ㅈ 的送气音。
exp.en: ㅊ is the aspirated counterpart of ㅈ.

q.en: Which of the following consonants is a nasal sound?

exp.zh: ㄴ 是鼻音，与 ㅁ、ㅇ 同为韩语鼻音。
exp.en: ㄴ is a nasal, along with ㅁ and ㅇ.

q.zh: 下列哪个辅音在音节开头不发音？
q.en: Which consonant is silent at the start of a syllable?

exp.zh: ㅇ 在音节开头是占位符，不发音。
exp.en: ㅇ is a placeholder at the start of a syllable and is not pronounced.

q.en: What is the pronunciation characteristic of 「ㄹ」?

zh: 根据位置发 r 或 l 音
en: Varies between 'r' and 'l' depending on position

exp.zh: ㄹ 在元音间偏 r，在词尾或辅音前偏 l。
exp.en: ㄹ sounds more like 'r' between vowels and 'l' at the end or before consonants.

q.zh: 下列哪个辅音发音类似英语「ng」？
q.en: Which consonant is pronounced like English 'ng'?

exp.zh: ㅇ 在音节末尾发 ng 音。
exp.en: ㅇ is pronounced 'ng' at the end of a syllable.

q.zh: 韩语一共有多少个基本元音？
q.en: How many basic vowels does Korean have?

exp.zh: 韩语基本元音共 10 个：ㅏ ㅑ ㅓ ㅕ ㅗ ㅛ ㅜ ㅠ ㅡ ㅣ。
exp.en: Korean has 10 basic vowels: ㅏ ㅑ ㅓ ㅕ ㅗ ㅛ ㅜ ㅠ ㅡ ㅣ.

q.zh: 韩语一共有多少个基本辅音？
q.en: How many basic consonants does Korean have?

exp.zh: 韩语基本辅音共 14 个：ㄱ ㄴ ㄷ ㄹ ㅁ ㅂ ㅅ ㅇ ㅈ ㅊ ㅋ ㅌ ㅍ ㅎ。
exp.en: Korean has 14 basic consonants: ㄱ ㄴ ㄷ ㄹ ㅁ ㅂ ㅅ ㅇ ㅈ ㅊ ㅋ ㅌ ㅍ ㅎ.

q.en: Is 「ㅏ」 a vowel or a consonant?

exp.zh: ㅏ 是元音。
exp.en: ㅏ is a vowel.

q.en: Is 「ㄱ」 a vowel or a consonant?

exp.zh: ㄱ 是辅音。
exp.en: ㄱ is a consonant.

q.en: Which of the following is a vowel?

exp.zh: ㅏ 是元音，其余为辅音。
exp.en: ㅏ is a vowel; the others are consonants.

q.en: Which of the following is a consonant?

exp.zh: ㄱ 是辅音，其余为元音。
exp.en: ㄱ is a consonant; the others are vowels.

q.zh: 韩语字母系统的名称是？
q.en: What is the name of the Korean writing system?

exp.zh: 韩语字母系统称为「谚文」或「한글」（Hangul）。
exp.en: The Korean alphabet is called Hangul (한글).

q.en: Who created the Korean alphabet (한글)?

exp.zh: 한글 由朝鲜王朝第四代国王世宗大王（세종대왕）主持创制。
exp.en: Hangul was created under King Sejong the Great (세종대왕) of the Joseon Dynasty.

q.zh: 韩语字母（한글）创造于哪一年？
q.en: In what year was the Korean alphabet (한글) created?

exp.zh: 한글 创制于 1443 年，1446 年正式颁布。
exp.en: Hangul was created in 1443 and promulgated in 1446.

q.en: What is the role of 「ㅇ」 at the start of a syllable?

exp.zh: 韩语音节必须以辅音开头，ㅇ 作为占位符用于元音开头的音节。
exp.en: Every Korean syllable must begin with a consonant; ㅇ serves as a silent placeholder for vowel-initial syllables.

q.zh: 下列哪个是韩语中的紧音？
q.en: Which of the following is a tense consonant in Korean?

exp.zh: ㄲ 是ㄱ 的紧音，发音时喉部紧张、不送气。
exp.en: ㄲ is the tense version of ㄱ, pronounced with a tightened throat and no aspiration.

papers.titleZh: 试卷 2：复合母音、双辅音与紧音 / 복합 모음·쌍자음·경음
papers.titleEn: Paper 2: Compound Vowels, Double & Tense Consonants

q.en: How is the Korean letter 「ㅐ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: ㅐ 是复合元音，读作 ae，类似英语 'e' in 'bed'，但嘴张得更大。
exp.en: ㅐ is a compound vowel, pronounced 'ae', like 'e' in 'bed' but with a wider mouth.

q.en: How is the Korean letter 「ㅔ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: ㅔ 读作 e，类似英语 'e' in 'bed'。
exp.en: ㅔ is pronounced 'e', like 'e' in 'bed'.

q.en: What is the difference between 「ㅐ」 and 「ㅔ」 in modern Korean?

zh: ㅐ 更开口，ㅔ 更闭口
en: ㅐ is more open, ㅔ is more closed

exp.zh: 现代韩语中 ㅐ 和 ㅔ 的发音已几乎合并，但书写仍不同。
exp.en: In modern Korean, ㅐ and ㅔ are almost merged in pronunciation, though they are still written differently.

q.en: How is the Korean letter 「ㅒ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: ㅒ 读作 yae，是 ㅐ 加上 y 音。
exp.en: ㅒ is pronounced 'yae', the ㅐ sound with a y-glide.

q.en: How is the Korean letter 「ㅖ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: ㅖ 读作 ye，是 ㅔ 加上 y 音。
exp.en: ㅖ is pronounced 'ye', the ㅔ sound with a y-glide.

q.en: How is the Korean letter 「ㅘ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: ㅘ 由 ㅗ + ㅏ 组合而成，读作 wa。
exp.en: ㅘ is a combination of ㅗ + ㅏ, pronounced 'wa'.

q.en: How is the Korean letter 「ㅙ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: ㅙ 由 ㅗ + ㅐ 组合而成，读作 wae。
exp.en: ㅙ is a combination of ㅗ + ㅐ, pronounced 'wae'.

q.en: How is the Korean letter 「ㅚ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: ㅚ 读作 oe 或 we，现代韩语多读 we。
exp.en: ㅚ is pronounced 'oe' or 'we'; in modern Korean, 'we' is common.

q.en: How is the Korean letter 「ㅝ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: ㅝ 由 ㅜ + ㅓ 组合而成，读作 wo。
exp.en: ㅝ is a combination of ㅜ + ㅓ, pronounced 'wo'.

q.en: How is the Korean letter 「ㅞ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: ㅞ 由 ㅜ + ㅔ 组合而成，读作 we。
exp.en: ㅞ is a combination of ㅜ + ㅔ, pronounced 'we'.

q.en: How is the Korean letter 「ㅟ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: ㅟ 读作 wi，是 ㅜ + ㅣ 的组合。
exp.en: ㅟ is pronounced 'wi', a combination of ㅜ + ㅣ.

q.en: How is the Korean letter 「ㅢ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: ㅢ 读作 ui，是 ㅡ + ㅣ 的组合。
exp.en: ㅢ is pronounced 'ui', a combination of ㅡ + ㅣ.

q.zh: 下列哪个元音的发音是「yae」？
q.en: Which vowel is pronounced 'yae'?

exp.zh: ㅒ 读作 yae。
exp.en: ㅒ is pronounced 'yae'.

q.zh: 下列哪个元音的发音是「wi」？
q.en: Which vowel is pronounced 'wi'?

exp.zh: ㅟ 读作 wi。
exp.en: ㅟ is pronounced 'wi'.

q.en: Which two vowels combine to form 「ㅘ」?

exp.zh: ㅘ = ㅗ + ㅏ。
exp.en: ㅘ = ㅗ + ㅏ.

q.en: How is the Korean letter 「ㄲ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: ㄲ 是ㄱ 的紧音，读作 kk，发音时喉部紧张、不送气。
exp.en: ㄲ is the tense version of ㄱ, pronounced 'kk' with a tightened throat and no aspiration.

q.en: How is the Korean letter 「ㄸ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: ㄸ 是ㄷ 的紧音，读作 tt，发音时喉部紧张、不送气。
exp.en: ㄸ is the tense version of ㄷ, pronounced 'tt' with a tightened throat and no aspiration.

q.en: How is the Korean letter 「ㅃ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: ㅃ 是ㅂ 的紧音，读作 pp，发音时喉部紧张、不送气。
exp.en: ㅃ is the tense version of ㅂ, pronounced 'pp' with a tightened throat and no aspiration.

q.en: How is the Korean letter 「ㅆ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: ㅆ 是ㅅ 的紧音，读作 ss，发音时更用力、更紧。
exp.en: ㅆ is the tense version of ㅅ, pronounced 'ss' with more force and tension.

q.en: How is the Korean letter 「ㅉ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: ㅉ 是ㅈ 的紧音，读作 jj，发音时喉部紧张、不送气。
exp.en: ㅉ is the tense version of ㅈ, pronounced 'jj' with a tightened throat and no aspiration.

q.zh: 下列哪个是韩语的紧音？
q.en: Which of the following is a tense consonant in Korean?

exp.zh: ㄲ 是ㄱ 的紧音。紧音的特点是发音时喉部紧张、不送气。
exp.en: ㄲ is the tense version of ㄱ. Tense consonants are pronounced with a tightened throat and no aspiration.

q.zh: 下列哪个是韩语的紧音？
q.en: Which of the following is a tense consonant in Korean?

exp.zh: ㅃ 是ㅂ 的紧音。
exp.en: ㅃ is the tense version of ㅂ.

q.zh: 韩语一共有多少个紧音（双辅音）？
q.en: How many tense (double) consonants does Korean have?

exp.zh: 韩语紧音共 5 个：ㄲ ㄸ ㅃ ㅆ ㅉ。
exp.en: Korean has 5 tense consonants: ㄲ ㄸ ㅃ ㅆ ㅉ.

q.en: What is the relationship among 「ㄱ / ㅋ / ㄲ」?

zh: 平音 / 送气音 / 紧音
平音 / 紧音 / 送气音

exp.zh: ㄱ 是平音，ㅋ 是送气音，ㄲ 是紧音。
exp.en: ㄱ is plain (lenis), ㅋ is aspirated, ㄲ is tense (fortis).

q.en: What is the relationship among 「ㄷ / ㅌ / ㄸ」?

zh: 平音 / 送气音 / 紧音
平音 / 紧音 / 送气音

exp.zh: ㄷ 是平音，ㅌ 是送气音，ㄸ 是紧音。
exp.en: ㄷ is plain, ㅌ is aspirated, ㄸ is tense.

q.en: What is the relationship among 「ㅂ / ㅍ / ㅃ」?

zh: 平音 / 紧音 / 送气音
平音 / 送气音 / 紧音

exp.zh: ㅂ 是平音，ㅍ 是送气音，ㅃ 是紧音。
exp.en: ㅂ is plain, ㅍ is aspirated, ㅃ is tense.

q.en: What is the relationship among 「ㅈ / ㅊ / ㅉ」?

zh: 平音 / 送气音 / 紧音

exp.zh: ㅈ 是平音，ㅊ 是送气音，ㅉ 是紧音。
exp.en: ㅈ is plain, ㅊ is aspirated, ㅉ is tense.

q.en: What is the main difference between 「ㅅ」 and 「ㅆ」?

exp.zh: ㅅ 是平音，ㅆ 是紧音。ㅆ 发音时更用力。
exp.en: ㅅ is plain; ㅆ is tense. ㅆ is pronounced with more force.

q.zh: 下列哪一组按「平音 / 送气音 / 紧音」排列？
q.en: Which group is ordered as 'Plain / Aspirated / Tense'?

exp.zh: ㄱ（平音）/ ㅋ（送气音）/ ㄲ（紧音）。
exp.en: ㄱ (plain) / ㅋ (aspirated) / ㄲ (tense).

q.zh: 下列哪种音发音时喉部最紧张、最用力？
q.en: Which type of sound is pronounced with the most tightened throat and force?

exp.zh: 紧音（ㄲ ㄸ ㅃ ㅆ ㅉ）发音时喉部最紧张、最用力，不送气。
exp.en: Tense consonants (ㄲ ㄸ ㅃ ㅆ ㅉ) are pronounced with the most throat tension, no aspiration.

papers.titleZh: 试卷 3：收音（终声）/ 받침

q.zh: 韩语收音（받침）一共有几个代表音？
q.en: How many representative final consonant sounds (받침) does Korean have?

exp.zh: 韩语收音共有 7 个代表音：ㄱ、ㄴ、ㄷ、ㄹ、ㅁ、ㅂ、ㅇ。所有收音在实际发音中都归入这 7 种之一。
exp.en: Korean has 7 representative final consonant sounds: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ, ㄹ, ㅁ, ㅂ, ㅇ. All final consonants reduce to one of these 7.

q.zh: 韩语收音的 7 个代表音是？
q.en: What are the 7 representative final consonant sounds in Korean?

zh: ㄱ ㄴ ㄷ ㄹ ㅁ ㅂ ㅇ
ㄱ ㄴ ㄷ ㄹ ㅁ ㅂ ㅅ
ㄱ ㄴ ㄷ ㄹ ㅁ ㅂ ㅎ
ㄱ ㄴ ㄷ ㄹ ㅁ ㅂ ㅈ
en: ㄱ ㄴ ㄷ ㄹ ㅁ ㅂ ㅇ
ㄱ ㄴ ㄷ ㄹ ㅁ ㅂ ㅅ
ㄱ ㄴ ㄷ ㄹ ㅁ ㅂ ㅎ
ㄱ ㄴ ㄷ ㄹ ㅁ ㅂ ㅈ

exp.zh: 7 个代表收音是 ㄱ、ㄴ、ㄷ、ㄹ、ㅁ、ㅂ、ㅇ。
exp.en: The 7 representative finals are ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ, ㄹ, ㅁ, ㅂ, ㅇ.

q.en: How is the final consonant 「ㄱ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: 收音 ㄱ 读作 k，类似英语 'k' in 'book'，但短促不收尾。
exp.en: Final ㄱ is pronounced 'k', like 'k' in 'book' but with no release.

q.en: How is the final consonant 「ㄴ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: 收音 ㄴ 读作 n，类似英语 'n' in 'sun'。
exp.en: Final ㄴ is pronounced 'n', like 'n' in 'sun'.

q.en: How is the final consonant 「ㄷ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: 收音 ㄷ 读作 t，短促不收尾。
exp.en: Final ㄷ is pronounced 't', with no release.

q.en: How is the final consonant 「ㄹ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: 收音 ㄹ 读作 l，类似英语 'l' in 'call'，但舌头要弹一下。
exp.en: Final ㄹ is pronounced 'l', like 'l' in 'call'.

q.en: How is the final consonant 「ㅁ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: 收音 ㅁ 读作 m，类似英语 'm' in 'time'。
exp.en: Final ㅁ is pronounced 'm', like 'm' in 'time'.

q.en: How is the final consonant 「ㅂ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: 收音 ㅂ 读作 p，短促不收尾。
exp.en: Final ㅂ is pronounced 'p', with no release.

q.en: How is the final consonant 「ㅇ」 pronounced?

exp.zh: ㅇ 在音节末尾时读作 ng，类似英语 'ng' in 'sing'。
exp.en: Final ㅇ is pronounced 'ng', like 'ng' in 'sing'.

q.zh: 收音「ㅅ」实际归入哪个代表音？
q.en: Which representative final does 「ㅅ」 reduce to?

exp.zh: 收音 ㅅ 实际发音为 [ㄷ]，即 t。类似的还有 ㅆ、ㅈ、ㅊ、ㅌ、ㅎ。
exp.en: Final ㅅ is actually pronounced [ㄷ] (t). Same for ㅆ, ㅈ, ㅊ, ㅌ, ㅎ.

q.zh: 收音「ㅈ」实际归入哪个代表音？
q.en: Which representative final does 「ㅈ」 reduce to?

exp.zh: 收音 ㅈ 实际发音为 [ㄷ]。
exp.en: Final ㅈ is actually pronounced [ㄷ] (t).

q.zh: 收音「ㅊ」实际归入哪个代表音？
q.en: Which representative final does 「ㅊ」 reduce to?

exp.zh: 收音 ㅊ 实际发音为 [ㄷ]。
exp.en: Final ㅊ is actually pronounced [ㄷ] (t).

q.zh: 收音「ㅋ」实际归入哪个代表音？
q.en: Which representative final does 「ㅋ」 reduce to?

exp.zh: 收音 ㅋ 实际发音为 [ㄱ]。
exp.en: Final ㅋ is actually pronounced [ㄱ] (k).

q.zh: 收音「ㅌ」实际归入哪个代表音？
q.en: Which representative final does 「ㅌ」 reduce to?

exp.zh: 收音 ㅌ 实际发音为 [ㄷ]。
exp.en: Final ㅌ is actually pronounced [ㄷ] (t).

q.zh: 收音「ㅍ」实际归入哪个代表音？
q.en: Which representative final does 「ㅍ」 reduce to?

exp.zh: 收音 ㅍ 实际发音为 [ㅂ]。
exp.en: Final ㅍ is actually pronounced [ㅂ] (p).

q.zh: 收音「ㅎ」实际归入哪个代表音？
q.en: Which representative final does 「ㅎ」 reduce to?

exp.zh: 收音 ㅎ 实际发音为 [ㄷ]，但在某些情况下会与后一个音节合并或脱落。
exp.en: Final ㅎ is usually [ㄷ] (t), though in some cases it combines with the following syllable or drops.

q.zh: 收音「ㅆ」实际归入哪个代表音？
q.en: Which representative final does 「ㅆ」 reduce to?

exp.zh: 收音 ㅆ 实际发音为 [ㄷ]。
exp.en: Final ㅆ is actually pronounced [ㄷ] (t).

q.en: Which sound does the double final 「ㄳ」 actually produce?

exp.zh: 双收音 ㄳ 通常只发前一个音 [ㄱ]。
exp.en: Double final ㄳ usually only pronounces the first component [ㄱ].

q.en: Which sound does the double final 「ㄵ」 actually produce?

exp.zh: 双收音 ㄵ 通常只发前一个音 [ㄴ]。
exp.en: Double final ㄵ usually only pronounces the first component [ㄴ].

q.en: Which sound does the double final 「ㄺ」 actually produce?

exp.zh: 双收音 ㄺ 通常发 [ㄱ]，但在某些语法结构中（如动词词干后接辅音）会发 [ㄹ]。
exp.en: Double final ㄺ usually produces [ㄱ], but in some grammatical contexts (e.g. verb stems before consonants) it produces [ㄹ].

q.en: Which sound does the double final 「ㄻ」 actually produce?

exp.zh: 双收音 ㄻ 通常只发后一个音 [ㅁ]。
exp.en: Double final ㄻ usually only pronounces the second component [ㅁ].

q.en: Which sound does the double final 「ㅄ」 actually produce?

exp.zh: 双收音 ㅄ 通常只发前一个音 [ㅂ]。
exp.en: Double final ㅄ usually only pronounces the first component [ㅂ].

q.zh: 下列哪个不是韩语的代表收音？
q.en: Which of the following is NOT a representative final consonant sound?

exp.zh: ㅅ 不是代表收音。代表收音只有 7 个：ㄱ ㄴ ㄷ ㄹ ㅁ ㅂ ㅇ。
exp.en: ㅅ is not a representative final. There are only 7: ㄱ ㄴ ㄷ ㄹ ㅁ ㅂ ㅇ.

q.en: What is 「받침」 usually translated as in English?

exp.zh: 받침 中文译为「收音」或「终声」，指音节末尾的辅音。
exp.en: 받침 means 'final consonant' — the consonant at the end of a syllable.

q.zh: 韩语收音在音节中的作用是？
q.en: What is the role of the final consonant (받침) in a Korean syllable?

exp.zh: 韩语音节结构为「辅音 + 元音 + 可选收音」。收音是音节末尾的辅音。
exp.en: A Korean syllable is 'consonant + vowel + optional final consonant'. The 받침 is the closing consonant.

papers.titleZh: 试卷 4：基础拼读与音变 / 연음과 음변

q.en: What is the rule of Korean linking (연음화)?

zh: 收音后接元音时，收音移到下一音节做初声
en: A final consonant moves to the next syllable's initial position before a vowel

exp.zh: 连音化：收音后接以元音开头的音节时，收音移到下一音节作初声。例：한국어 [한구거]。
exp.en: Linking: when a final consonant meets a vowel-initial syllable, it moves to become the next syllable's initial. E.g. 한국어 [한구거].

q.en: How is 「한국어」 pronounced with linking?

exp.zh: ㄱ 收音后接 어（元音开头），移到下一音节：한국어 [한구거]。
exp.en: Final ㄱ before 어 (vowel-initial) moves to the next syllable: 한국어 [한구거].

q.en: How is 「음악」 pronounced with linking?

exp.zh: ㅁ 收音后接 아，移到下一音节：음악 [으막]。
exp.en: Final ㅁ before 아 moves to the next syllable: 음악 [으막].

q.en: What is the rule of Korean nasalization (비음화)?

zh: 收音 ㄱㄷㅂ 后接 ㄴㅁ 时，变成 ㅇㄴㅁ
en: Finals ㄱ/ㄷ/ㅂ become ㅇ/ㄴ/ㅁ before ㄴ/ㅁ

exp.zh: 鼻音化：ㄱ→ㅇ、ㄷ→ㄴ、ㅂ→ㅁ，当前面收音遇 ㄴ/ㅁ 时。
exp.en: Nasalization: ㄱ→ㅇ, ㄷ→ㄴ, ㅂ→ㅁ before ㄴ or ㅁ.

q.en: How is 「한국말」 pronounced with nasalization?

exp.zh: 收音 ㄱ 遇 ㅁ，鼻音化为 ㅇ：한국말 [한궁말]。
exp.en: Final ㄱ before ㅁ nasalizes to ㅇ: 한국말 [한궁말].

q.en: How is 「국물」 pronounced with nasalization?

exp.zh: 收音 ㄱ 遇 ㅁ，鼻音化为 ㅇ：국물 [궁물]。
exp.en: Final ㄱ before ㅁ nasalizes to ㅇ: 국물 [궁물].

q.en: How is 「십만」 pronounced with nasalization?

exp.zh: 收音 ㅂ 遇 ㅁ，鼻音化为 ㅁ：십만 [심만]。
exp.en: Final ㅂ before ㅁ nasalizes to ㅁ: 십만 [심만].

q.en: What is the rule of Korean lateralization (유음화)?

zh: ㄴ + ㄹ 或 ㄹ + ㄴ → ㄹㄹ
en: ㄴ + ㄹ or ㄹ + ㄴ → ㄹㄹ

exp.zh: 流音化：ㄴ 和 ㄹ 相遇时，都变成 ㄹ。
exp.en: Lateralization: when ㄴ and ㄹ meet, both become ㄹ.

q.en: How is 「신라」 pronounced with lateralization?

exp.zh: ㄴ + ㄹ → ㄹㄹ：신라 [실라]。
exp.en: ㄴ + ㄹ → ㄹㄹ: 신라 [실라].

q.en: How is 「천리」 pronounced with lateralization?

exp.zh: ㄴ + ㄹ → ㄹㄹ：천리 [철리]。
exp.en: ㄴ + ㄹ → ㄹㄹ: 천리 [철리].

q.en: What is the rule of Korean aspiration (격음화)?

exp.zh: 激音化：平音 + ㅎ 合并为送气音。例：축하 [추카]。
exp.en: Aspiration: plain consonants + ㅎ merge into aspirated sounds. E.g. 축하 [추카].

q.en: How is 「축하」 pronounced with aspiration?

exp.zh: ㄱ + ㅎ → ㅋ：축하 [추카]。
exp.en: ㄱ + ㅎ → ㅋ: 축하 [추카].

q.en: How is 「좋다」 pronounced with aspiration?

exp.zh: ㅎ + ㄷ → ㅌ：좋다 [조타]。
exp.en: ㅎ + ㄷ → ㅌ: 좋다 [조타].

q.en: How is 「잡히다」 pronounced with aspiration?

exp.zh: ㅂ + ㅎ → ㅍ：잡히다 [자피다]。
exp.en: ㅂ + ㅎ → ㅍ: 잡히다 [자피다].

q.en: What is the rule of Korean tensification (경음화)?

zh: 收音 ㄱㄷㅂ 后接 ㄱㄷㅂㅅㅈ，后者变紧音
en: After finals ㄱ/ㄷ/ㅂ, the following ㄱ/ㄷ/ㅂ/ㅅ/ㅈ become tense

exp.zh: 紧音化：收音 ㄱㄷㅂ 后接 ㄱㄷㅂㅅㅈ 时，后者变紧音。例：학교 [학꾜]。
exp.en: Tensification: after finals ㄱ/ㄷ/ㅂ, a following ㄱ/ㄷ/ㅂ/ㅅ/ㅈ becomes tense. E.g. 학교 [학꾜].

q.en: How is 「학교」 pronounced with tensification?

exp.zh: 收音 ㄱ 后接 ㄱ，后一个 ㄱ 变紧音：학교 [학꾜]。
exp.en: After final ㄱ, the following ㄱ becomes tense: 학교 [학꾜].

q.en: How is 「잡다」 pronounced with tensification?

exp.zh: 收音 ㅂ 后接 ㄷ，ㄷ 变紧音：잡다 [잡따]。
exp.en: After final ㅂ, the following ㄷ becomes tense: 잡다 [잡따].

q.en: How is 「식당」 pronounced with tensification?

exp.zh: 收音 ㄱ 后接 ㄷ，ㄷ 变紧音：식당 [식땅]。
exp.en: After final ㄱ, the following ㄷ becomes tense: 식당 [식땅].

q.zh: 韩语「口盖音化（구개음화）」的规则是？
q.en: What is the rule of Korean palatalization (구개음화)?

exp.zh: 口盖音化：ㄷ、ㅌ 后接 이 时，变成 ㅈ、ㅊ。例：같이 [가치]。
exp.en: Palatalization: ㄷ/ㅌ before 이 become ㅈ/ㅊ. E.g. 같이 [가치].

q.en: How is 「같이」 pronounced with palatalization?

exp.zh: ㅌ + 이 → 치：같이 [가치]。
exp.en: ㅌ + 이 → 치: 같이 [가치].

q.en: How is 「굳이」 pronounced with palatalization?

exp.zh: ㄷ + 이 → 지：굳이 [구지]。
exp.en: ㄷ + 이 → 지: 굳이 [구지].

q.en: How is the ㅎ in 「좋아요」 pronounced?

exp.zh: ㅎ 在元音之间会脱落：좋아요 [조아요]。
exp.en: ㅎ between vowels is dropped: 좋아요 [조아요].

q.en: How is 「놓아」 pronounced?

exp.zh: ㅎ 在元音之间脱落：놓아 [노아]。
exp.en: ㅎ between vowels is dropped: 놓아 [노아].

q.en: How is 「옷이」 pronounced with linking?

exp.zh: 收音 ㅅ 后接 이，ㅅ 移到下一音节作初声，读作 [시]：옷이 [오시]。
exp.en: Final ㅅ before 이 moves to the next syllable as [시]: 옷이 [오시].

q.zh: 韩语音变规则中，下列哪一项使「收音移到下一音节」？

exp.zh: 连音化：收音后接元音时，收音移到下一音节。
exp.en: Linking: a final consonant moves to the next syllable before a vowel.

papers.titleZh: 试卷 1：基础助词（기본 조사）

q.en: 저___ 학생입니다. (Fill in the correct particle)

exp.zh: 「저」是主题，「은/는」表主题。저无收音，用는。
exp.en: 저 is the topic; 은/는 marks the topic. 저 has no final consonant, so use 는.

q.zh: 책___ 책상 위에 있습니다.（填入正确的助词）
q.en: 책___ 책상 위에 있습니다. (Fill in the correct particle)

exp.zh: 「책」是新信息的主语，「이/가」表主语。책有收音ㄱ，用이。
exp.en: 책 is the subject (new information); 이/가 marks the subject. 책 has final ㄱ, so use 이.

q.en: 사과___ 먹습니다. (Fill in the correct particle)

exp.zh: 「사과」是宾语，「을/를」表宾语。사과无收音，用를。
exp.en: 사과 is the object; 을/를 marks the object. 사과 has no final consonant, so use 를.

q.en: 학교___ 갑니다. (Fill in the correct particle)

exp.zh: 「에」表方向（去某处）。
exp.en: 에 marks direction (going to a place).

q.en: 집___ 공부합니다. (Fill in the correct particle)

exp.zh: 「에서」表动作发生的场所。学习是动作，用에서。
exp.en: 에서 marks the place where an action occurs. Studying is an action, so use 에서.

q.en: 저___ 책입니다. (Fill in the correct particle)

exp.zh: 「의」表所有格，相当于「的」。
exp.en: 의 marks possession, equivalent to 's / of'.

q.en: What is the main difference between 「은/는」 and 「이/가」?

zh: 은/는 表主题，이/가 表主语
en: 은/는 marks the topic; 이/가 marks the subject

exp.zh: 은/는 强调「关于…」，이/가 强调「是…（谁/什么）」。
exp.en: 은/는 emphasizes 'as for ...'; 이/가 emphasizes 'it is (who/what)'.

q.en: What is the main difference between 「에」 and 「에서」?

zh: 에 表方向/存在场所，에서 表动作场所
에 表时间，에서 表方向
en: 에 marks direction/existence; 에서 marks the place of an action
에 marks time; 에서 marks direction

exp.zh: 「학교에 가다」（方向）、「학교에서 공부하다」（动作场所）。
exp.en: 학교에 가다 (direction); 학교에서 공부하다 (place of action).

q.zh: 동생___ 학교에 갑니다.（填入正确的助词）
q.en: 동생___ 학교에 갑니다. (Fill in the correct particle)

exp.zh: 「동생」是新信息主语，用이/가。동생有收音ㅇ，用이。
exp.en: 동생 is the subject (new information). 동생 has final ㅇ, so use 이.

q.en: 물___ 마십니다. (Fill in the correct particle)

exp.zh: 「물」是宾语，用을/를。물有收音ㄹ，用을。
exp.en: 물 is the object. 물 has final ㄹ, so use 을.
