q.en: What is the haeyo-form (present) of 「가다」?

exp.zh: 가다 的词干 가 + 아요，合并为 가요。
exp.en: The stem 가 + 아요, contracted to 가요.

q.en: What is the haeyo-form (present) of 「하다」?

exp.zh: 하다 的해요体固定为 해요（不规则）。
exp.en: 하다 has the irregular haeyo-form 해요.

q.en: What is the haeyo-form (present) of 「오다」?

exp.zh: 오다 的词干 오 + 아요，合并为 와요。
exp.en: The stem 오 + 아요, contracted to 와요.

q.en: What is the negative form of 「먹다」?

exp.zh: 短否定：안 + 动词。안 먹어요（不吃）。
exp.en: Short negation: 안 + verb. 안 먹어요 (do not eat).

q.en: What is the haeyo-form (present) of 「공부하다」?

exp.zh: 하다 类动词的해요体：공부하다 → 공부해요。
exp.en: 하다-verbs form haeyo as: 공부하다 → 공부해요.

q.en: What is the haeyo-form (present) of 「보다」?

exp.zh: 보다 的词干 보 + 아요，合并为 봐요。
exp.en: The stem 보 + 아요, contracted to 봐요.

q.en: What is the haeyo-form (present) of 「자다」?

exp.zh: 자다 的词干 자 + 아요，合并为 자요。
exp.en: The stem 자 + 아요, contracted to 자요.

q.en: What is the haeyo-form (present) of 「마시다」?

exp.zh: 마시다（ㅣ结尾）的词干 마시 + 어요，合并为 마셔요。
exp.en: Stem 마시 (ending in ㅣ) + 어요, contracted to 마셔요.

q.en: Which haeyo-form means 'is ...' after a noun?

exp.zh: 名词 + 이에요（有收音）/ 예요（无收音）。如：학생이에요、의사예요。
exp.en: Noun + 이에요 (after final consonant) / 예요 (after vowel). E.g. 학생이에요, 의사예요.

papers.titleZh: 试卷 3：过去式与将来式（과거형과 미래형）

q.en: What is the past tense (haeyo-form) of 「먹다」?

exp.zh: 词干 먹 + 었어요 → 먹었어요。
exp.en: Stem 먹 + 었어요 → 먹었어요.

q.en: What is the past tense (haeyo-form) of 「가다」?

exp.zh: 词干 가 + 았어요，合并为 갔어요。
exp.en: Stem 가 + 았어요, contracted to 갔어요.

q.en: What is the past tense (haeyo-form) of 「하다」?

exp.zh: 하다 的过去式为 했어요（不规则）。
exp.en: The past of 하다 is 했어요 (irregular).

q.en: What is the past tense (haeyo-form) of 「오다」?

exp.zh: 词干 오 + 았어요，合并为 왔어요。
exp.en: Stem 오 + 았어요, contracted to 왔어요.

q.en: What is the future tense (haeyo-form) of 「먹다」?

exp.zh: 将来式：词干 + 을/ㄹ 거예요。먹有收音ㄱ，用을：먹을 거예요。
exp.en: Future: stem + 을/ㄹ 거예요. 먹 has final ㄱ, so use 을: 먹을 거예요.

q.en: What is the future tense (haeyo-form) of 「가다」?

exp.zh: 가 无收音，用 ㄹ：갈 거예요。
exp.en: 가 has no final consonant, so use ㄹ: 갈 거예요.

q.en: What is the past tense (haeyo-form) of 「보다」?

exp.zh: 词干 보 + 았어요，合并为 봤어요。
exp.en: Stem 보 + 았어요, contracted to 봤어요.

q.en: What is the past tense (haeyo-form) of 「자다」?

exp.zh: 词干 자 + 았어요，合并为 잤어요。
exp.en: Stem 자 + 았어요, contracted to 잤어요.

q.en: What is the past tense (haeyo-form) of 「공부하다」?

exp.zh: 하다 类动词的过去式：공부하다 → 공부했어요。
exp.en: 하다-verbs in the past: 공부하다 → 공부했어요.

q.en: What is the past tense (haeyo-form) of 「마시다」?

exp.zh: 마시 的词干 + 었어요，合并为 마셨어요。
exp.en: Stem 마시 + 었어요, contracted to 마셨어요.

papers.titleZh: 试卷 4：数字与量词（ 숫자와 단위）

q.en: Which number does the Sino-Korean numeral 「오」 represent?

exp.en: Sino-Korean numerals: 일(1) 이(2) 삼(3) 사(4) 오(5) 육(6) 칠(7) 팔(8) 구(9) 십(10).

q.en: Which number does the native Korean numeral 「넷」 represent?

exp.en: Native Korean numerals: 하나(1) 둘(2) 셋(3) 넷(4) 다섯(5) 여섯(6) 일곱(7) 여덟(8) 아홉(9) 열(10).

q.en: Which number does the Sino-Korean numeral 「십」 represent?
Which number does the native Korean numeral 「다섯」 represent?

exp.zh: 다섯 = 5。
exp.en: 다섯 = 5.

q.en: What does 「한 명」 mean?

exp.zh: 명（名）是人的量词。한 명 = 一个人。
exp.en: 명 is the counter for people. 한 명 = one person.

q.en: What does 「세 시」 mean?

exp.zh: 시（时）是时间的量词。세 시 = 三点。
exp.en: 시 is the counter for time (o'clock). 세 시 = three o'clock.

q.en: What does the counter 「개」 count?

exp.zh: 개 用于数物品，相当于中文的「个」。
exp.en: 개 counts items, like 'pieces' or 'items'.

q.en: What does the counter 「명」 count?

exp.zh: 명 用于数人，相当于中文的「名/位」。
exp.en: 명 counts people.

q.zh: 固有数词「하나」在量词前会变成？
q.en: How does the native Korean numeral 「하나」 change before a counter?

exp.zh: 固有数词 1-4 在量词前变化：하나→한、둘→두、셋→세、넷→네。
exp.en: Native numerals 1–4 shorten before counters: 하나→한, 둘→두, 셋→세, 넷→네.

q.en: Which number does the Sino-Korean numeral 「이」 represent?

papers.titleZh: 试卷 5：日常会话（일상 회화）

q.en: What does 「안녕하세요」 mean?

exp.zh: 안녕하세요 是韩语最常用的问候语，意为「你好」。
exp.en: 안녕하세요 is the most common Korean greeting, meaning 'hello'.

q.en: What does 「감사합니다」 mean?

exp.zh: 감사합니다 是「谢谢」的正式说法。
exp.en: 감사합니다 is the formal way to say 'thank you'.

q.en: What does 「죄송합니다」 mean?

exp.zh: 죄송합니다 是「对不起」的正式说法。
exp.en: 죄송합니다 is the formal way to say 'sorry'.

q.en: What does 「안녕히 가세요」 mean?

exp.zh: 안녕히 가세요 是对离开的人说的「再见」。
exp.en: 안녕히 가세요 is said to someone who is leaving.

q.en: What does 「만나서 반갑습니다」 mean?

exp.zh: 初次见面时说「만나서 반갑습니다」，意为「很高兴见到你」。
exp.en: 만나서 반갑습니다 means 'nice to meet you' and is said when meeting someone for the first time.

q.en: What does 「이름이 뭐예요?」 mean?

exp.zh: 이름（名字）+ 이 뭐예요?（是什么？）= 你叫什么名字？
exp.en: 이름 (name) + 이 뭐예요? (what is?) = 'What is your name?'

q.en: What does 「얼마예요?」 mean?

exp.zh: 얼마 意为「多少」，얼마예요? 是购物时询问价格的说法。
exp.en: 얼마 means 'how much'; 얼마예요? asks for a price when shopping.

q.en: What does 「주세요」 mean?

exp.zh: 주세요 是「请给我」的意思，用于点餐、购物。
exp.en: 주세요 means 'please give me', used when ordering or shopping.

q.en: What does 「맛있어요」 mean?

exp.zh: 맛（味道）+ 있어요（有）= 好吃。
exp.en: 맛 (taste) + 있어요 (there is) = delicious.

q.en: What does 「괜찮아요」 mean?

exp.zh: 괜찮아요 可表示「没关系」「我没事」「还行」。
exp.en: 괜찮아요 can mean 'it's okay', 'I'm fine', or 'not bad'.

papers.titleZh: 试卷 1：不规则动词与形容词（불규칙 동사와 형용사）
papers.titleEn: Paper 1: Irregular Verbs & Adjectives (불규칙 동사와 형용사)

q.en: What is the haeyo-form of 「춥다」 (cold)?

exp.zh: ㅂ不规则：词干춥的ㅂ变우，加어요→추워요。
exp.en: ㅂ-irregular: the ㅂ in the stem 춥 becomes 우, then add 어요 → 추워요.

q.en: What is the haeyo-form of 「덥다」 (hot)?

exp.zh: ㅂ不规则：덥 → 더우 + 어요 → 더워요。
exp.en: ㅂ-irregular: 덥 → 더우 + 어요 → 더워요.

q.en: What is the haeyo-form of 「듣다」 (to listen)?

exp.zh: ㄷ不规则：词干듣的ㄷ变ㄹ，加어요→들어요。
exp.en: ㄷ-irregular: the ㄷ in the stem 듣 becomes ㄹ, then add 어요 → 들어요.

q.en: What is the haeyo-form of 「걷다」 (to walk)?

exp.zh: ㄷ不规则：걷 → 걸 + 어요 → 걸어요。
exp.en: ㄷ-irregular: 걷 → 걸 + 어요 → 걸어요.

q.en: What is the haeyo-form of 「짓다」 (to build/make)?

exp.zh: ㅅ不规则：词干짓的ㅅ脱落，加어요→지어요。
exp.en: ㅅ-irregular: the ㅅ in the stem 짓 drops, then add 어요 → 지어요.

q.en: What is the haeyo-form of 「낫다」 (to be better/recover)?

exp.zh: ㅅ不规则：낫 → 나 + 아요 → 나아요。
exp.en: ㅅ-irregular: 낫 → 나 + 아요 → 나아요.

q.en: What is the haeyo-form of 「모르다」 (to not know)?

exp.zh: 르不规则：르变ㄹㄹ，모르→몰라，加요→몰라요。
exp.en: 르-irregular: 르 becomes ㄹㄹ. 모르 → 몰라 + 요 → 몰라요.

q.en: What is the haeyo-form of 「부르다」 (to sing/call)?

exp.zh: 르不规则：부르 → 불러 + 요 → 불러요。
exp.en: 르-irregular: 부르 → 불러 + 요 → 불러요.

q.en: What is the haeyo-form of 「쓰다」 (to write/use)?

exp.zh: 으不规则：词干쓰的ㅡ脱落，加어요→써요。
exp.en: 으-irregular: the ㅡ in the stem 쓰 drops, then add 어요 → 써요.

q.en: What is the haeyo-form of 「살다」 (to live)? (Note the special ㄹ rule)

exp.zh: ㄹ不规则：살的ㄹ在元音前保留，加아요→살아요。
exp.en: ㄹ-irregular: the ㄹ in 살 is kept before a vowel, so add 아요 → 살아요.

papers.titleZh: 试卷 2：连接词尾（연결 어미）

q.zh: 表示「并列/顺序」的连接词尾是？
q.en: Which connecting ending expresses 'and / and then'?

exp.zh: 「-고」表并列或动作的顺序：밥을 먹고 갔어요（吃完饭去了）。
exp.en: -고 marks coordination or sequence: 밥을 먹고 갔어요 (ate and then left).

q.zh: 表示「转折」的连接词尾是？
q.en: Which connecting ending expresses 'but / although'?

exp.zh: 「-지만」表转折：피곤하지만 공부해요（虽然累但学习）。
exp.en: -지만 marks contrast: 피곤하지만 공부해요 (tired but studying).

q.zh: 表示「条件（如果）」的连接词尾是？
q.en: Which connecting ending expresses 'if'?

exp.zh: 「-면」表条件：비가 오면 안 가요（如果下雨就不去）。
exp.en: -면 marks a condition: 비가 오면 안 가요 (if it rains, I won't go).

q.zh: 表示「原因」的连接词尾是？
q.en: Which connecting ending expresses 'because'?

exp.zh: 「-아/어서」表原因：비가 와서 못 갔어요（因为下雨没去）。
exp.en: -아/어서 marks cause: 비가 와서 못 갔어요 (because it rained, couldn't go).

q.en: What does 「비가 와서 못 갔어요」 mean?

en: Because it rained, I couldn't go
If it rains, I won't go

exp.zh: -아/어서 表原因 + 못（不能）：因为下雨没能去。
exp.en: -아/어서 marks cause + 못 (cannot): because it rained, I couldn't go.

q.en: What does 「피곤하지만 공부해요」 mean?

exp.zh: -지만 表转折：虽然累但学习。
exp.en: -지만 marks contrast: although tired, I study.

q.zh: 比「-아/어서」更正式的原因连接词尾是？
q.en: Which cause ending is more formal than 「-아/어서」?

exp.zh: 「-니까」表原因，比-아/어서更正式。例：늦었으니까 빨리 가세요。
exp.en: -니까 marks cause and is more formal than -아/어서. E.g. 늦었으니까 빨리 가세요.

q.en: What does 「밥을 먹고 학교에 갔어요」 mean?

en: Because I ate, I didn't go to school
Ate and then went to school
Want to eat before going to school

exp.zh: -고 表动作顺序：吃完饭去了学校。
exp.en: -고 marks sequence: ate and then went to school.

q.zh: 表示「目的（去做某事）」的连接词尾是？
q.en: Which connecting ending expresses 'in order to do'?

exp.zh: 「-러」表目的，常与가다/오다连用：한국어를 배우러 한국에 갔어요。
exp.en: -러 marks purpose, often with 가다/오다: 한국어를 배우러 한국에 갔어요.

q.en: What does 「한국어를 배우러 한국에 갔어요」 mean?

en: Went to Korea to learn Korean

exp.zh: -러 表目的：为了学韩语去了韩国。
exp.en: -러 marks purpose: went to Korea in order to learn Korean.

papers.titleZh: 试卷 3：冠形词形（관형사형）

q.zh: 动词现在时修饰名词用哪个形式？
q.en: Which form does a verb use to modify a noun in the present tense?

exp.zh: 动词现在时：-는。例：먹는 사람（正在吃的人）。
exp.en: Verb present: -는. E.g. 먹는 사람 (the person eating).

q.zh: 动词过去时修饰名词用哪个形式？
q.en: Which form does a verb use to modify a noun in the past tense?

exp.zh: 动词过去时：-은/ㄴ。例：먹은 사람（吃过的人）。
exp.en: Verb past: -은/ㄴ. E.g. 먹은 사람 (the person who ate).

q.zh: 动词将来时修饰名词用哪个形式？
q.en: Which form does a verb use to modify a noun in the future tense?

exp.zh: 动词将来时：-을/ㄹ。例：먹을 사람（要吃的人）。
exp.en: Verb future: -을/ㄹ. E.g. 먹을 사람 (the person who will eat).

q.zh: 形容词修饰名词（现在）用哪个形式？
q.en: Which form does an adjective use to modify a noun (present)?

exp.zh: 形容词现在时：-은/ㄴ。例：예쁜 꽃（漂亮的花）。
exp.en: Adjective present: -은/ㄴ. E.g. 예쁜 꽃 (pretty flower).

q.en: What does 「먹는 사람」 mean?

exp.zh: 먹 + 는 + 사람：正在吃的人。
exp.en: 먹 + 는 + 사람: the person eating (present).

q.en: What does 「먹은 사람」 mean?

exp.zh: 먹 + 은 + 사람：吃过的人（过去）。
exp.en: 먹 + 은 + 사람: the person who ate (past).

q.en: What does 「먹을 사람」 mean?

exp.zh: 먹 + 을 + 사람：要吃的人（将来）。
exp.en: 먹 + 을 + 사람: the person who will eat (future).

q.en: What is the dictionary form of 「예쁜」 in 「예쁜 꽃」?

exp.zh: 예쁘다（ㅡ脱落）→ 예쁜。
exp.en: 예쁘다 (ㅡ drops) → 예쁜.

q.en: What does 「읽는 책」 mean?

exp.zh: 읽 + 는 + 책：正在读的书（现在时定语）。
exp.en: 읽 + 는 + 책: the book being read (present modifier).

q.en: What is the dictionary form of 「산」 in 「작년에 산 차」?

exp.zh: 사다（买）→ 산（过去定语）。
exp.en: 사다 (to buy) → 산 (past modifier).

papers.titleZh: 试卷 4：比较与程度（비교와 정도）

q.en: Which particle expresses 'A is more ... than B'?

exp.zh: 「보다」表比较：사과가 배보다 맛있어요（苹果比梨好吃）。
exp.en: 보다 marks comparison: 사과가 배보다 맛있어요 (apples are tastier than pears).

q.en: What does 「사과가 배보다 맛있어요」 mean?

en: Apples and pears are equally tasty
Apples are less tasty than pears

exp.zh: A가 B보다 ~：A 比 B 更 ~。
exp.en: A가 B보다 ~: A is more ~ than B.

q.en: Which adverb means 'the most'?

exp.zh: 제일 / 가장：最。例：이게 제일 좋아요（这个最好）。
exp.en: 제일 / 가장: the most. E.g. 이게 제일 좋아요 (this is the best).

q.en: What does 「오늘이 어제보다 더워요」 mean?

en: Today and yesterday are equally hot

exp.zh: 오늘이 어제보다：今天比昨天。더워요：热。
exp.en: 오늘이 어제보다: today more than yesterday. 더워요: hot.

q.en: Which particle means 'like / as ... as'?

exp.zh: 「처럼」表相似：새처럼 날고 싶어요（想如鸟一样飞翔）。
exp.en: 처럼 marks similarity: 새처럼 날고 싶어요 (I want to fly like a bird).

q.zh: 表示「达到…程度」的助词是？
q.en: Which particle expresses 'to the extent of ...'?

exp.zh: 「만큼」表程度：형만큼 키가 커요（和哥哥一样高）。
exp.en: 만큼 expresses extent: 형만큼 키가 커요 (as tall as my brother).

q.en: What does 「형만큼 키가 커요」 mean?

en: My brother is taller than me

exp.zh: 만큼 表程度：和哥哥一样高。
exp.en: 만큼 marks extent: as tall as my brother.

q.en: Which adverb means 'more'?

exp.zh: 「더」表示更：더 먹어요（再吃点）。
exp.en: 더 means 'more': 더 먹어요 (eat more).

q.en: What does 「이게 제일 좋아요」 mean?

exp.zh: 제일（最）+ 좋아요（好）= 最好。
exp.en: 제일 (most) + 좋아요 (good) = the best.

q.en: What does 「동생은 저보다 어려요」 mean?

en: My younger sibling is older than me
My younger sibling is younger than me
My younger sibling is the same age as me

exp.zh: 저보다（比我）+ 어려요（年轻）= 比我小。
exp.en: 저보다 (than me) + 어려요 (young) = younger than me.

papers.titleZh: 试卷 5：敬语与半语（존댓말과 반말）

q.zh: 敬语词尾「-시-」加在动词词干后，表示？
q.en: What does the honorific suffix 「-시-」 express when added to a verb stem?

exp.zh: 「-시-」提高主语的尊敬度：선생님이 가세요（老师去）。
exp.en: -시- raises the subject's status: 선생님이 가세요 (the teacher goes).

q.en: What is the honorific form of 「먹다」?

exp.zh: 「드시다」是먹다的敬语，比잡수시다更常用。
exp.en: 드시다 is the honorific form of 먹다, more common than 잡수시다.

q.en: What is the honorific form of 「있다」?

exp.zh: 「계시다」是있다的敬语，用于尊敬主语。
exp.en: 계시다 is the honorific form of 있다, used to respect the subject.

q.en: What is the honorific form of 「자다」?

exp.zh: 「주무시다」是자다的敬语。
exp.en: 주무시다 is the honorific form of 자다.

q.en: What is the honorific word for 「나이」 (age)?

exp.zh: 「연세」是나이的敬语，问长辈年龄时说연세。
exp.en: 연세 is the honorific word for 나이; use it when asking an elder's age.

q.en: What is the honorific word for 「밥」 (meal)?

exp.zh: 「진지」是밥的敬语，多用于长辈。식사更一般。
exp.en: 진지 is the honorific word for 밥, usually for elders. 식사 is more general.

q.en: Which speech style should you use with elders?

exp.zh: 对长辈、陌生人用존댓말（敬语）。
exp.en: Use 존댓말 (honorific speech) with elders and strangers.

q.zh: 对亲近的朋友说话可以用？
q.en: Which speech style can you use with close friends?

exp.zh: 对亲近的朋友、晚辈用반말（半语/平语）。
exp.en: Use 반말 (casual speech) with close friends and juniors.

q.zh: 「할아버지께서 진지를 잡수세요」中，「잡수세요」是哪个词的敬语？
q.en: In 「할아버지께서 진지를 잡수세요」, what is the honorific word 「잡수세요」 based on?

exp.zh: 「잡수시다」是먹다的敬语，比드시다更尊敬。
exp.en: 잡수시다 is the honorific form of 먹다, more honorific than 드시다.

q.zh: 「선생님께서 교실에 계세요」中，「계세요」是哪个词的敬语？
q.en: In 「선생님께서 교실에 계세요」, what is the honorific word 「계세요」 based on?

exp.zh: 「계시다」是있다的敬语，表示「在（某处）」。
exp.en: 계시다 is the honorific form of 있다, meaning 'to be (somewhere)'.

papers.titleZh: 试卷 1：间接引语（간접 인용）

q.zh: 陈述句的间接引语用哪个词尾？
q.en: Which ending is used for indirect speech of a statement?

exp.zh: 陈述句间接引语：词干 + -다고 하다。例：간다고 했어요（说要去）。
exp.en: Statements take -다고 하다: 간다고 했어요 (said he/she is going).

q.zh: 疑问句的间接引语用哪个词尾？
q.en: Which ending is used for indirect speech of a question?

exp.zh: 疑问句间接引语：-냐고 하다（或 -느냐고 하다）。例：가냐고 물었어요（问去不去）。
exp.en: Questions take -냐고 하다: 가냐고 물었어요 (asked whether he/she is going).

q.zh: 命令句的间接引语用哪个词尾？
q.en: Which ending is used for indirect speech of a command?

exp.zh: 命令句间接引语：-(으)라고 하다。例：앉으라고 했어요（让坐下）。
exp.en: Commands take -(으)라고 하다: 앉으라고 했어요 (told him/her to sit).

q.zh: 共动句（提议）的间接引语用哪个词尾？
q.en: Which ending is used for indirect speech of a suggestion ('let's')?

exp.zh: 共动句间接引语：-자고 하다。例：같이 가자고 했어요（提议一起去）。
exp.en: Suggestions take -자고 하다: 같이 가자고 했어요 (suggested going together).

q.en: What does 「밥을 먹는다고 했어요」 mean?

en: Said that he/she is eating / will eat

exp.zh: -ㄴ/는다고 하다 是陈述句间接引语：说了在吃饭。
exp.en: -ㄴ/는다고 하다 is indirect speech for statements: said that he/she is eating.

q.en: What does 「어디에 가냐고 물었어요」 mean?

exp.zh: -냐고 묻다 = 问…。问了要去哪里。
exp.en: -냐고 묻다 means 'asked whether/where'. Asked where he/she is going.

q.en: What does 「천천히 하라고 했어요」 mean?

en: Told me to do it slowly

exp.zh: -(으)라고 하다 表命令：让我慢慢做。
exp.en: -(으)라고 하다 marks commands: told me to do it slowly.

q.en: What does 「같이 가자고 했어요」 mean?

exp.zh: -자고 하다 表提议：提议一起去。
exp.en: -자고 하다 marks suggestions: suggested going together.

q.zh: 名词的间接引语（「是学生」）用哪个词尾？
q.en: Which ending is used for indirect speech of a noun statement ('is a student')?

exp.zh: 名词 + -(이)라고 하다。例：학생이라고 했어요（说是学生）。
exp.en: Noun + -(이)라고 하다: 학생이라고 했어요 (said he/she is a student).

q.en: What is the colloquial contraction of 「-다고 했어요」?

exp.zh: -다고 했어요 → -댔어요（口语中常见）。
exp.en: -다고 했어요 contracts to -댔어요 in casual speech.

papers.titleZh: 试卷 2：被动与使役（피동과 사동）

q.en: What is the passive form of 「보다」 (to see)?

exp.zh: 보다 的被动形是 보이다（被看见／看得见）。
exp.en: The passive of 보다 is 보이다 (to be seen / to be visible).

q.en: In 「문이 열렸어요」, what form is 「열리다」?

exp.zh: 열리다 是 열다（开）的被动：门被打开了。
exp.en: 열리다 is the passive of 열다 (to open): the door was opened.

q.en: What form is 「먹이다」?

exp.zh: 먹이다 是 먹다 的使役：喂（让吃）。
exp.en: 먹이다 is the causative of 먹다: to feed (make someone eat).

q.en: What does 「-게 하다」 express?

exp.zh: -게 하다 是最通用的使役结构：웃게 하다（让人笑）。
exp.en: -게 하다 is the most general causative pattern: 웃게 하다 (make someone laugh).

q.en: What does 「아이를 웃겼어요」 mean?

exp.zh: 웃기다 是 웃다 的使役：把孩子逗笑了。
exp.en: 웃기다 is the causative of 웃다: made the child laugh.

q.en: What does 「도둑이 잡혔어요」 mean?

exp.zh: 잡히다 是 잡다（抓）的被动：小偷被抓了。
exp.en: 잡히다 is the passive of 잡다 (to catch): the thief was caught.

q.en: What is 「-시키다」 mainly used for?

zh: 汉字词名词 + 시키다 构成使役

exp.zh: 汉字词名词 + 시키다：공부시키다（让学习）、이해시키다（让人理解）。
exp.en: Sino-Korean noun + 시키다: 공부시키다 (make someone study), 이해시키다 (make someone understand).

q.en: What does 「동생에게 책을 읽게 했어요」 mean?

en: My sibling was read a book
Made my sibling read a book
Read a book with my sibling

exp.zh: -게 하다 使役：让弟弟读书。
exp.en: -게 하다 causative: made my sibling read a book.

q.en: What is the difference between passive and causative?

zh: 被动：主语被做；使役：主语让做
en: Passive: the subject receives the action; causative: the subject makes someone act

exp.zh: 被动：门被开了（문이 열렸다）；使役：我让门开了（문을 열게 했다）。
exp.en: Passive: the door was opened (문이 열렸다); causative: I made the door open (문을 열게 했다).

q.en: In 「길이 막혔어요」, what form is 「막히다」?

en: Passive of 막다 (the road is blocked)

exp.zh: 막히다 是 막다（堵）的被动：路被堵了。
exp.en: 막히다 is the passive of 막다 (to block): the road is blocked.

papers.titleZh: 试卷 3：推测与意志（추측과 의지）

q.en: What does 「-겠-」 mainly express?

exp.zh: -겠- 可表说话人意志（제가 하겠습니다）或推测（비가 오겠어요）。
exp.en: -겠- expresses the speaker's volition (제가 하겠습니다) or conjecture (비가 오겠어요).

q.en: What does 「-(으)ㄹ 것이다」 mainly express?

exp.zh: -(으)ㄹ 것이다 表将来计划或推测：내일 갈 거예요（明天打算去）。
exp.en: -(으)ㄹ 것이다 marks future plans or conjecture: 내일 갈 거예요 (I plan to go tomorrow).

q.en: What does 「-(으)ㄹ 것 같다」 mainly express?

exp.zh: -(으)ㄹ 것 같다 表推测：비가 올 것 같아요（好像要下雨）。
exp.en: -(으)ㄹ 것 같다 marks conjecture: 비가 올 것 같아요 (it seems it will rain).

q.en: What does 「-나 보다」 mainly express?

exp.zh: -나 보다 表示基于观察的推测：아직 안 왔나 봐요（看来还没来）。
exp.en: -나 보다 expresses conjecture based on observation: 아직 안 왔나 봐요 (looks like he/she hasn't come yet).

q.en: What does 「비가 올 것 같아요」 mean?

exp.zh: -(으)ㄹ 것 같다：好像要下雨。
exp.en: -(으)ㄹ 것 같다: it seems it will rain.

q.en: What does 「내일 갈 거예요」 mean?

exp.zh: -(으)ㄹ 것이다 表将来计划：明天打算去。
exp.en: -(으)ㄹ 것이다 marks future plans: I plan to go tomorrow.

q.en: What does 「제가 하겠습니다」 express?

exp.zh: -겠- 表说话人意志：我来做。
exp.en: -겠- expresses the speaker's volition: I'll do it.

q.en: What is the difference between 「-나 보다」 and 「-것 같다」?

zh: -것 같다 比 -나 보다 更依赖证据
-나 보다 比 -것 같다 更依赖观察到的证据
en: -것 같다 relies more on evidence than -나 보다
-나 보다 relies more on observed evidence than -것 같다

exp.zh: -나 보다 更强调「从观察到的迹象推断」；-것 같다 是更通用的「好像」。
exp.en: -나 보다 emphasizes inference from observed signs; -것 같다 is a more general 'seems'.

q.en: What does 「-아/어 보이다」 express?

exp.zh: -아/어 보이다 表视觉印象：맛있어 보여요（看起来好吃）。
exp.en: -아/어 보이다 marks visual impression: 맛있어 보여요 (looks delicious).

q.en: What is the main difference between 「-겠-」 and 「-(으)ㄹ 것이다」?

zh: -겠- 更常用于第一人称意志；-(으)ㄹ 것이다 更常用于第三人称推测／计划
en: -겠- is more common for first-person volition; -(으)ㄹ 것이다 for third-person conjecture/plans

exp.zh: 제가 하겠습니다（第一人称意志）／그가 갈 것이다（第三人称推测）。
exp.en: 제가 하겠습니다 (1st-person volition) / 그가 갈 것이다 (3rd-person conjecture).

papers.titleZh: 试卷 4：进阶连接词尾（심화 연결 어미）
papers.titleEn: Paper 4: Advanced Connecting Endings (심화 연결 어미)

q.en: What does 「-는데」 mainly express?

exp.zh: -는데 表背景或轻微转折：비가 오는데 우산이 없어요（在下雨，可我没伞）。
exp.en: -는데 sets the background or mild contrast: 비가 오는데 우산이 없어요 (it's raining, but I have no umbrella).

q.en: What does 「-면서」 express?

exp.zh: -면서 表同时进行：음악을 들으면서 공부해요（边听音乐边学习）。
exp.en: -면서 marks simultaneous actions: 음악을 들으면서 공부해요 (studying while listening to music).

q.en: What does 「-더라도」 express?

exp.zh: -더라도 表让步：아무리 바쁘더라도 밥은 먹어요（再忙也吃饭）。
exp.en: -더라도 marks concession: 아무리 바쁘더라도 밥은 먹어요 (even if busy, I eat).

q.en: What does 「-도록」 mainly express?

exp.zh: -도록 可表目的（잊지 않도록 메모하세요）或程度（목이 아프도록 말했어요）。
exp.en: -도록 marks purpose (잊지 않도록 메모하세요) or extent (목이 아프도록 말했어요).

q.en: What is the difference between 「-기 때문에」 and 「-아/어서」?

zh: -기 때문에 更书面，且可用于命令句之后
en: -기 때문에 is more formal and can precede commands

exp.zh: -아/어서 后面不能接命令句；-기 때문에 可以：비가 오기 때문에 우산을 가져가세요。
exp.en: -아/어서 cannot precede a command; -기 때문에 can: 비가 오기 때문에 우산을 가져가세요.

q.en: What does 「비가 오는데 우산이 없어요」 mean?

en: It's raining, but I have no umbrella
Because it rained, I brought an umbrella

exp.zh: -는데 表背景＋轻微转折：在下雨，可我没伞。
exp.en: -는데 sets background + mild contrast: it's raining, but I have no umbrella.

q.en: What does 「음악을 들으면서 공부해요」 mean?

en: Listen to music in order to study

exp.zh: -면서 表同时：一边听音乐一边学习。
exp.en: -면서 marks simultaneity: studying while listening to music.

q.en: What does 「아무리 바빠도 밥은 먹어요」 mean?

en: Because I'm busy, I don't eat
I eat only when not busy

exp.zh: 아무리 + -아/어도 表让步：再忙也吃饭。
exp.en: 아무리 + -아/어도 marks concession: even if busy, I eat.

q.en: What are the two main meanings of 「-도록」?

zh: 目的（为了）和程度（到…地步）
en: Purpose (in order to) and extent (to the point of)

exp.zh: -도록：①目的 잊지 않도록（为了不忘记）②程度 웃도록（到笑的地步）。
exp.en: -도록: (1) purpose 잊지 않도록 (so as not to forget); (2) extent 웃도록 (to the point of laughing).

q.en: What is the difference between 「-는데」 and 「-지만」?

zh: -는데 更柔和、常作背景铺垫；-지만 转折更直接
en: -는데 is softer and often sets the background; -지만 marks a more direct contrast
Both are used only in writing

exp.zh: -는데 语气柔和，常铺垫背景；-지만 转折明显：비가 오지만 갈 거예요。
exp.en: -는데 is softer and sets the background; -지만 marks clear contrast: 비가 오지만 갈 거예요.

papers.titleZh: 试卷 5：敬语进阶与正式体（심화 존댓말과 격식체）
papers.titleEn: Paper 5: Advanced Honorifics & Formal Style (심화 존댓말과 격식체)

q.en: Where is the formal style (-ㅂ니다/습니다) mainly used?

exp.zh: -ㅂ니다/습니다 是正式体，用于演讲、新闻、对长辈或客户。
exp.en: -ㅂ니다/습니다 is the formal style, used in speeches, news, and with elders or clients.

q.en: What is the difference between the 해요 style and the 합니다 style?

en: 합니다 is more formal than 해요

exp.zh: 합니다体比해요体更正式：감사합니다（正式）／고마워요（一般礼貌）。
exp.en: 합니다 is more formal than 해요: 감사합니다 (formal) / 고마워요 (polite).

q.en: Which particle fills the blank in 「선생님___ 오십니다」?

exp.zh: 尊敬主语时用 께서 代替 이/가：선생님께서 오십니다。
exp.en: With an honored subject, 께서 replaces 이/가: 선생님께서 오십니다.

q.en: In 「선생님께서 오십니다」, what is the role of 「-시-」?

exp.zh: -시- 提高主语的尊敬度：오시다（来，敬语）。
exp.en: -시- honors the subject: 오시다 (to come, honorific).

q.en: What is the honorific form of 「자다」 (to sleep)?

exp.zh: 주무시다 是 자다 的敬语。
exp.en: 주무시다 is the honorific form of 자다.

q.en: What is 「연세가 어떻게 되세요?」 asking?

exp.zh: 연세 是 나이（年龄）的敬语，用于问长辈。
exp.en: 연세 is the honorific word for 나이 (age), used with elders.

q.en: In 「제가 말씀드리겠습니다」, what does 「말씀드리다」 demonstrate?

exp.zh: 말씀드리다 是谦让语：我（谦逊地）说。
exp.en: 말씀드리다 is a humble form: I (humbly) say.

q.en: Which word is 「말씀」 the honorific form of?

exp.zh: 말씀 是 말（话）的敬语。
exp.en: 말씀 is the honorific form of 말 (words/speech).

q.en: What is the difference between 「-습니다」 and 「-ㅂ니다」?

zh: -습니다 用于无收音词干，-ㅂ니다 用于有收音
-습니다 用于有收音词干，-ㅂ니다 用于无收音
en: -습니다 after stems without a final consonant; -ㅂ니다 after stems with one
-습니다 after stems with a final consonant; -ㅂ니다 after stems without one

exp.zh: 有收音：먹습니다；无收音：갑니다。
exp.en: With final consonant: 먹습니다; without: 갑니다.

q.zh: 正式场合道谢，最恰当的说法是？
q.en: Which is the most appropriate way to thank someone in a formal setting?

exp.zh: 감사드립니다 是 감사합니다 的谦让形式，最正式。
exp.en: 감사드립니다 is the humble form of 감사합니다, the most formal.

papers.titleZh: 试卷 1：惯用语与四字成语（관용구와 사자성어）

q.en: What does 「발이 넓다」 mean?

exp.zh: 발이 넓다：字面「脚宽」，实际指人脉广。
exp.en: 발이 넓다 literally 'feet are wide', means 'well-connected'.

q.en: What does 「눈이 높다」 mean?

exp.zh: 눈이 높다：字面「眼睛高」，实际指眼光高、挑剔。
exp.en: 눈이 높다 literally 'eyes are high', means 'has high standards'.

q.en: What does 「손이 크다」 mean?

zh: 花钱大手大脚／出手阔绰

exp.zh: 손이 크다：字面「手大」，实际指花钱大方。
exp.en: 손이 크다 literally 'hands are big', means 'spends generously'.

q.en: What does 「입이 무겁다」 mean?

exp.zh: 입이 무겁다：嘴严、守得住秘密。反义是입이 가볍다。
exp.en: 입이 무겁다 means 'keeps secrets'. Opposite: 입이 가볍다.

q.zh: 「一石二鳥」对应的韩语四字成语是？
q.en: Which Korean four-character idiom corresponds to 'kill two birds with one stone'?

exp.zh: 일석이조（一石二鳥）：一块石头打两只鸟，一举两得。
exp.en: 일석이조 (一石二鳥): one stone, two birds — kill two birds with one stone.

q.en: What does 「새옹지마」 mean?

en: Misfortune may be a blessing in disguise

exp.zh: 새옹지마（塞翁之馬）：比喻祸福难料。
exp.en: 새옹지마 (塞翁之馬): fortune and misfortune are unpredictable.

q.en: What does 「오십보백보」 mean?

en: Fifty steps and one hundred steps
Fifty is faster than one hundred
Much the same / Six of one, half a dozen of the other

exp.zh: 오십보백보（五十步百步）：比喻两者差别不大。
exp.en: 오십보백보 (五十步百步): little difference between the two.

q.en: What does 「이심전심」 mean?

exp.zh: 이심전심（以心伝心）：不用言语也能心意相通。
exp.en: 이심전심 (以心伝心): hearts communicate without words.

q.en: What does 「금상첨화」 mean?

en: Adding flowers to brocade / Making a good thing better

exp.zh: 금상첨화（錦上添花）：比喻好上加好。
exp.en: 금상첨화 (錦上添花): making a good thing even better.

q.en: In 「발이 넓다」, what does 「발」 represent?

exp.zh: 「발」在此指社会活动圈，발이 넓다 = 活动圈广。
exp.en: 발 here refers to one's social circle; 발이 넓다 = has a wide social circle.

papers.titleZh: 试卷 2：俗语与谚语（속담）

q.en: What does 「티끌 모아 태산」 mean?

zh: 灰尘堆积成山（积少成多）
en: Small things add up (many a little makes a mickle)

exp.zh: 티끌 모아 태산：灰尘积成泰山，比喻积少成多。
exp.en: 티끌 모아 태산: dust piled up becomes Mount Tai — small things add up.

q.en: What does 「원숭이도 나무에서 떨어진다」 mean?

exp.zh: 원숭이도 나무에서 떨어진다：连猴子都会从树上掉下来，比喻再专业也会失误。
exp.en: 원숭이도 나무에서 떨어진다: even a monkey falls from a tree — even experts make mistakes.

q.en: What does 「가재는 게 편」 mean?

zh: 龙虾站在螃蟹这边（同类相护）
en: Crayfish sides with the crab (birds of a feather)

exp.zh: 가재는 게 편：龙虾偏向螃蟹，比喻同类相护。
exp.en: 가재는 게 편: the crayfish sides with the crab — birds of a feather flock together.

q.en: What does 「하늘의 별 따기」 mean?

exp.zh: 하늘의 별 따기：摘天上的星星，比喻极难。
exp.en: 하늘의 별 따기: picking stars from the sky — extremely difficult.

q.en: What does 「빈대 잡으려고 초가삼간 태운다」 mean?

zh: 为了抓臭虫烧了三间草房（因小失大）
en: Burns a three-room thatched house to catch a bug (overreacting / ruinous)

exp.zh: 빈대 잡으려고 초가삼간 태운다：为抓臭虫烧整栋房子，比喻因小失大。
exp.en: Burn a thatched house to catch a bug — sacrifice too much for a small gain.

q.zh: 「낮 말은 새가 듣고 밤 말은 쥐가 듣는다」的意思是？
q.en: What does 「낮 말은 새가 듣고 밤 말은 쥐가 듣는다」 mean?

en: Birds sing by day, rats by night
Walls have ears / Be careful what you say

exp.zh: 낮 말은 새가 듣고 밤 말은 쥐가 듣는다：白天的话鸟会听，晚上的话鼠会听，比喻隔墙有耳。
exp.en: Birds hear daytime talk, rats hear nighttime talk — walls have ears.

q.en: What does 「고생 끝에 낙이 온다」 mean?

zh: 苦难之后快乐到来（苦尽甘来）
en: After hardship comes joy (no pain, no gain)

exp.zh: 고생 끝에 낙이 온다：苦尽甘来。
exp.en: 고생 끝에 낙이 온다: after hardship comes joy.

q.en: What does 「우물 안 개구리」 mean?

exp.zh: 우물 안 개구리：井底之蛙，比喻见识短浅。
exp.en: 우물 안 개구리: a frog in a well — narrow-minded.

q.zh: 「말 한마디에 천 냥 빚을 갚는다」的意思是？
q.en: What does 「말 한마디에 천 냥 빚을 갚는다」 mean?

zh: 好好说话能还千两债／良言一句三冬暖
en: One word is worth a lot
A kind word can repay a thousand-nyang debt (kind words are powerful)

exp.zh: 말 한마디에 천 냥 빚을 갚는다：好话一句值千两，比喻言语力量大。
exp.en: A single good word can repay a thousand-nyang debt — words have great power.

q.zh: 「발 없는 말이 천 리 간다」的意思是？
q.en: What does 「발 없는 말이 천 리 간다」 mean?

zh: 没有脚的话走千里（消息传得快）
en: Words without feet travel a thousand ri (news spreads fast)

exp.zh: 발 없는 말이 천 리 간다：话没脚也能传千里，比喻消息传得很快。
exp.en: Words without feet travel a thousand ri — news spreads fast.

papers.titleZh: 试卷 3：书面语与口语差异（문어와 구어）
papers.titleEn: Paper 3: Written vs Spoken Korean (문어와 구어)

q.en: Which spoken form corresponds to the written 「그러나」?

exp.zh: 그러나（书面）＝하지만（口语）：但是。
exp.en: 그러나 (written) = 하지만 (spoken): 'however'.

q.en: Which spoken form corresponds to the written 「또한」?

exp.zh: 또한（书面）＝또（口语）：而且、还。
exp.en: 또한 (written) = 또 (spoken): 'also / moreover'.

q.en: Which spoken form corresponds to the written 「따라서」?

exp.zh: 따라서（书面）＝그래서（口语）：因此。
exp.en: 따라서 (written) = 그래서 (spoken): 'therefore'.

q.en: Which spoken form corresponds to the written 「왜냐하면」?

exp.zh: 왜냐하면（书面）＝왜냐면（口语）：因为。
exp.en: 왜냐하면 (written) = 왜냐면 (spoken): 'because'.

q.en: Which spoken form corresponds to the written 「및」?

exp.zh: 및（书面）＝와/과（口语）：和、以及。
exp.en: 및 (written) = 와/과 (spoken): 'and'.

q.zh: 书面语「-에 대하여」对应的口语是？
q.en: Which spoken form corresponds to the written 「-에 대하여」?

exp.zh: -에 대하여（书面）＝-에 대해（口语）：关于。
exp.en: -에 대하여 (written) = -에 대해 (spoken): 'regarding'.

q.en: Which spoken form corresponds to the written noun-forming 「-ㅁ/음」?

exp.zh: -ㅁ/음（书面）＝-는 것（口语）：将动词名词化。例：배움（书面）/ 배우는 것（口语）。
exp.en: -ㅁ/음 (written) = -는 것 (spoken): nominalizing. E.g. 배움 (written) / 배우는 것 (spoken).

q.en: Which spoken form corresponds to the written 「-고자」?

exp.zh: -고자（书面）＝-려고（口语）：为了。例：배우고자 합니다 / 배우려고 해요。
exp.en: -고자 (written) = -려고 (spoken): 'in order to'.

q.zh: 「보고서」这类文字主要使用哪种文体？
q.en: Which style is mainly used in a report (보고서)?

exp.zh: 报告、新闻等书面语通常用합니다体或-다体。
exp.en: Reports, news, etc. use 합니다 or -다 style.

q.en: What style is 「-ㄴ/는다」?

exp.zh: -ㄴ/는다 是书面语（-다体），用于新闻报道、文章、日记。
exp.en: -ㄴ/는다 is the written (-다) style, used in news, articles, and diaries.

papers.titleZh: 试卷 4：新闻阅读理解（뉴스 독해）

q.en: In news, what does 「~에 따르면」 mean?

exp.zh: ~에 따르면 引出信息来源：根据…。
exp.en: ~에 따르면 introduces the source: 'according to ...'.

q.en: In news, what does 「~로 밝혀졌다」 mean?

exp.zh: 밝혀지다：被查明、被揭示。
exp.en: 밝혀지다 means 'to be revealed / made clear'.

q.en: In news, what does 「~것으로 보인다」 mean?

exp.zh: ~것으로 보인다：据观察／推测。新闻常用。
exp.en: ~것으로 보인다: 'it appears that'. Common in news.

q.en: In news, what does 「~에 대한」 mean?

exp.zh: ~에 대한：关于…的（书面表达）。
exp.en: ~에 대한 means 'about / regarding' (written form).

q.en: In news, what does 「~를 계기로」 mean?

exp.zh: ~를 계기로：以…为契机。
exp.en: ~를 계기로 means 'taking ... as an opportunity'.

q.en: In news, what does 「~을 앞두고」 mean?

exp.zh: ~을 앞두고：在…即将到来之前。
exp.en: ~을 앞두고 means 'ahead of / about to'.

q.en: In news, what does 「~에 힘입어」 mean?

exp.zh: ~에 힘입어：借助…的力量、由于…。
exp.en: ~에 힘입어 means 'thanks to / driven by'.

q.zh: 新闻标题「정부, 대책 마련 나서」中的「나서」表示？
q.en: In the headline 「정부, 대책 마련 나서」, what does 「나서」 indicate?

en: About to start / Beginning to act

exp.zh: 나서다：出面、着手。新闻标题常用。
exp.en: 나서다 means 'to step forward / begin to act'. Common in headlines.

q.zh: 新闻中「~는 것으로 나타났다」的意思是？
q.en: In news, what does 「~는 것으로 나타났다」 mean?

en: It was found / Results show that

exp.zh: ~는 것으로 나타났다：调查/结果显示。
exp.en: ~는 것으로 나타났다 means 'it was found / results show that'.

q.zh: 新闻中「~에 대해 논의했다」的意思是？
q.en: In news, what does 「~에 대해 논의했다」 mean?

exp.zh: 논의하다：讨论。~에 대해 논의했다：就…进行了讨论。
exp.en: 논의하다 means 'to discuss'. ~에 대해 논의했다: discussed about ...

papers.titleZh: 试卷 5：高级语法（고급 문법）

q.en: What does 「-더니」 mainly express?

zh: 过去的经历（我亲身经历）
对过去的观察＋结果变化
en: Observation of the past + resulting change

exp.zh: -더니：我观察到…，结果发生了变化。例：어제는 춥더니 오늘은 따뜻해요。
exp.en: -더니: I observed ..., and as a result, a change occurred. E.g. 어제는 춥더니 오늘은 따뜻해요.

q.en: What does 「-거든」 mainly express?

exp.zh: -거든 表假设：비가 오거든 우산을 챙겨요（如果下雨就带伞）。
exp.en: -거든 marks a hypothetical: 비가 오거든 우산을 챙겨요 (if it rains, take an umbrella).

q.en: What does 「-길래」 mainly express?

exp.zh: -길래：因为听/看到某事，所以做了某反应。例：비가 오길래 우산을 샀어요。
exp.en: -길래: reacting after hearing/seeing something. E.g. 비가 오길래 우산을 샀어요.

q.en: What does 「-기는 하지만」 mean?

exp.zh: -기는 하지만：承认前半句，但后半句转折。例：맛있기는 하지만 비싸요。
exp.en: -기는 하지만: acknowledges the first clause but contrasts. E.g. 맛있기는 하지만 비싸요.

q.en: What does 「-는 바람에」 mainly express?

zh: 因为（意外原因）导致负面结果
en: Due to an unexpected cause leading to a negative result

exp.zh: -는 바람에：因为（意外）导致负面结果。例：늦잠을 자는 바람에 지각했어요。
exp.en: -는 바람에: due to an unexpected cause leading to a negative result. E.g. 늦잠을 자는 바람에 지각했어요.

q.en: What does 「-기 마련이다」 mean?

exp.zh: -기 마련이다：必然、总是会。例：사람은 늙기 마련이다。
exp.en: -기 마련이다: 'is bound to / naturally'. E.g. 사람은 늙기 마련이다.

q.en: What does 「-고 말다」 mainly express?

exp.zh: -고 말다：最终（遗憾地）发生了。例：결국 울고 말았어요。
exp.en: -고 말다: ended up (regrettably). E.g. 결국 울고 말았어요.

q.en: What does 「-다 보면」 mean?

exp.zh: -다 보면：坚持做下去的话就会…。例：연습하다 보면 늘어요。
exp.en: -다 보면: if you keep doing ..., (then) ... E.g. 연습하다 보면 늘어요.

q.en: What does 「-는 대신에」 mean?

exp.zh: -는 대신에：代替、作为交换。例：커피 대신에 차를 마셔요。
exp.en: -는 대신에 means 'instead / in exchange'. E.g. 커피 대신에 차를 마셔요.

q.en: What does 「-기로 하다」 mean?

exp.zh: -기로 하다：决定做…。例：내일부터 운동하기로 했어요。
exp.en: -기로 하다 means 'decide to do'. E.g. 내일부터 운동하기로 했어요.

papers.titleZh: 试卷 1：高级敬语与正式文书（고급 존댓말과 격식 문서）
papers.titleEn: Paper 1: Advanced Honorifics & Formal Documents (고급 존댓말과 격식 문서)

q.en: What is 「뵙다」 the humble form of?

exp.zh: 뵙다 是 보다（见）的谦让语，用于我去见长辈时。例：내일 선생님을 뵙겠습니다。
exp.en: 뵙다 is the humble form of 보다 (to see/meet), used when the speaker visits a superior.

q.en: What is 「여쭙다」 the humble form of?

exp.zh: 여쭙다 是 묻다（问）的谦让语，用于向长辈提问。
exp.en: 여쭙다 is the humble form of 묻다 (to ask), used when asking a superior.

q.en: What is 「드리다」 the humble form of?

exp.zh: 드리다 是 주다（给）的谦让语，用于我给别人（尤其长辈）东西。
exp.en: 드리다 is the humble form of 주다 (to give), used when giving to a superior.

q.zh: 对长辈说「请吃」，最恰当的是？
q.en: Which is the most appropriate way to say 'please eat' to a superior?

exp.zh: 드세요 是 먹다 的敬语命令形；更敬的说法是 잡수세요。
exp.en: 드세요 is the honorific imperative of 먹다; an even more honorific form is 잡수세요.

q.en: What is 「계시다」 the honorific form of?

exp.zh: 계시다 是 있다 的敬语，表示长辈「在」某处。
exp.en: 계시다 is the honorific form of 있다, used when a superior is 'present'.

q.en: Which phrase is commonly used to close a formal document?

exp.zh: 正式文书、报告结尾常用「이상입니다」（以上）。
exp.en: Formal documents and reports often close with 이상입니다 ('that is all').

q.en: What is 「성함」 the honorific form of?

exp.zh: 성함 是 이름（名字）的敬语，问长辈名字时用。
exp.en: 성함 is the honorific form of 이름 (name), used when asking a superior's name.

q.en: What is 「댁」 the honorific form of?

exp.zh: 댁 是 집（家）的敬语，指长辈的家。
exp.en: 댁 is the honorific form of 집 (home), referring to a superior's house.

q.en: Convert 「할아버지가 밥을 먹었어요」 to correct honorific speech:

exp.zh: 对长辈最敬的说法是 잡수셨어요（잡수시다 + 었어요）。
exp.en: The most honorific form for a superior is 잡수셨어요 (잡수시다 + 었어요).

q.en: What is 「모시다」 the humble form of?

exp.zh: 모시다 是 데리다（带/陪同）的谦让语，表示陪同长辈。
exp.en: 모시다 is the humble form of 데리다 (to escort/accompany), used when accompanying a superior.

papers.titleZh: 试卷 2：汉字词与固有词辨析（한자어와 고유어）
papers.titleEn: Paper 2: Sino-Korean vs Native Korean (한자어와 고유어)

q.zh: 韩语中 1–99 的数词主要用哪套？
q.en: Which numeral system is mainly used for 1–99 in Korean?

exp.zh: 1–99 常用固有数词（하나, 둘, 셋…），但分钟等场景用汉字词。
exp.en: Native numerals (하나, 둘, 셋…) are used for 1–99, though minutes use Sino-Korean.

q.en: Which numeral system is used for numbers 100 and above?

exp.zh: 100 以上用汉字数词（백, 천, 만…）。
exp.en: Sino-Korean numerals (백, 천, 만…) are used for 100 and above.

q.en: What type of word is 「사과」?

exp.zh: 사과（沙果）是汉字词。
exp.en: 사과 (沙果) is a Sino-Korean word.

q.en: What type of word is 「하늘」?

exp.zh: 하늘（天空）是固有词。
exp.en: 하늘 (sky) is a native Korean word.

q.en: Which numeral system is used with the age counter 「살」?

exp.zh: 年龄用固有数词 + 살（열 살, 스무 살…），正式场合也用汉字词 + 세。
exp.en: Ages use native numerals + 살 (열 살, 스무 살…), though formal settings use Sino-Korean + 세.

q.en: Which numeral system is used with the minute counter 「분」?

exp.zh: 分钟用汉字数词 + 분（삼 분, 오 분…）。
exp.en: Minutes use Sino-Korean numerals + 분 (삼 분, 오 분…).

q.en: Which numeral system is used with the hour counter 「시」?

exp.zh: 小时用固有数词 + 시（한 시, 두 시…）。
exp.en: Hours use native numerals + 시 (한 시, 두 시…).

q.en: What type of word is 「물」?

exp.zh: 물（水）是固有词。
exp.en: 물 (water) is a native Korean word.

q.en: What type of word is 「학교」?

exp.zh: 학교（学校）是汉字词。
exp.en: 학교 (school) is a Sino-Korean word.

q.en: What type of word is 「사람」?

exp.zh: 사람（人）是固有词。
exp.en: 사람 (person) is a native Korean word.

papers.titleZh: 试卷 3：高级惯用语与俚语（고급 관용구와 속어）
papers.titleEn: Paper 3: Advanced Idioms & Slang (고급 관용구와 속어)

q.en: What does 「손을 떼다」 mean?

en: Wash one's hands of / Stop participating

exp.zh: 손을 떼다 字面「放手」，实际指「撒手不干／退出」。
exp.en: 손을 떼다 literally 'to release one's hand', means 'to wash one's hands of / stop participating'.

q.en: What does 「발을 빼다」 mean?

exp.zh: 발을 빼다 字面「拔脚」，实际指「退出（某事）」。
exp.en: 발을 빼다 literally 'to pull one's foot out', means 'to withdraw from something'.

q.en: What does 「눈에 밟히다」 mean?

exp.zh: 눈에 밟히다 字面「被踩在眼里」，实际指「（某人的样子）历历在目」。
exp.en: 눈에 밟히다 literally 'to be stepped on in the eye', means 'lingers vividly in one's mind'.

q.en: What does 「입에 침이 마르다」 mean?

exp.zh: 입에 침이 마르다 字面「嘴里口水干了」，实际指「反复地说／赞不绝口」。
exp.en: 입에 침이 마르다 literally 'one's mouth runs dry', means 'to say something repeatedly / praise endlessly'.

q.en: What does 「귀가 얇다」 mean?

exp.zh: 귀가 얇다 字面「耳朵薄」，实际指「耳根软／容易听信别人」。
exp.en: 귀가 얇다 literally 'thin ears', means 'easily persuaded / credulous'.

q.en: What does 「간이 크다」 mean?

exp.zh: 간이 크다 字面「肝大」，实际指「胆子大」。
exp.en: 간이 크다 literally 'big liver', means 'bold / brave'.

q.en: What does 「속이 타다」 mean?

exp.zh: 속이 타다 字面「里面烧焦」，实际指「心急如焚」。
exp.en: 속이 타다 literally 'the inside burns', means 'to burn with anxiety'.

q.en: What does 「머리를 굴리다」 mean?

exp.zh: 머리를 굴리다 字面「滚脑袋」，实际指「动脑筋」。
exp.en: 머리를 굴리다 literally 'to roll one's head', means 'to think hard'.

q.en: What does 「얼굴이 두껍다」 mean?

exp.zh: 얼굴이 두껍다 字面「脸厚」，实际指「脸皮厚／不知羞耻」。
exp.en: 얼굴이 두껍다 literally 'thick face', means 'shameless / thick-skinned'.

q.en: What is the slang meaning of 「배가 아프다」?

exp.zh: 배가 아프다 字面「肚子疼」，俚语中指「嫉妒」。
exp.en: 배가 아프다 literally 'stomach hurts', slang means 'jealous / envious'.

papers.titleZh: 试卷 4：文学作品选读（문학 작품 읽기）
papers.titleEn: Paper 4: Korean Literature Reading (문학 작품 읽기)

q.en: Who wrote 「토지」?

exp.zh: 《토지》是박경리的大河小说，描写近代朝鲜农村。
exp.en: 토지 is a multi-volume novel by 박경리, depicting rural Korea in the modern era.

q.en: Who wrote 「소나기」?

exp.zh: 《소나기》是황순원的短篇名作。
exp.en: 소나기 is a famous short story by 황순원.

q.en: Who wrote 「무정」?

exp.zh: 《무정》是이광수1917年发表的长篇，被视为韩国近代小说开端。
exp.en: 무정 is a novel by 이광수 published in 1917, regarded as the beginning of modern Korean fiction.

q.en: Who wrote 「운수 좋은 날」?

exp.zh: 《운수 좋은 날》是현진건的短篇名作。
exp.en: 운수 좋은 날 is a famous short story by 현진건.

q.en: Who wrote 「사랑손님과 어머니」?

exp.zh: 《사랑손님과 어머니》是주요섭的短篇。
exp.en: 사랑손님과 어머니 is a short story by 주요섭.

q.en: Who wrote 「난장이가 쏘아올린 작은 공」?

exp.zh: 《난장이가 쏘아올린 작은 공》是조세희的短篇集，描写产业化的阴影。
exp.en: 난장이가 쏘아올린 작은 공 is a short-story collection by 조세희 about the shadows of industrialization.

q.en: Who wrote 「서시」?

exp.zh: 《서시》是윤동주（尹东柱）的代表诗。
exp.en: 서시 is a representative poem by 윤동주.

q.en: Who wrote 「진달래꽃」?

exp.zh: 《진달래꽃》是김소월（金素月）的代表诗。
exp.en: 진달래꽃 is a representative poem by 김소월.

q.en: Who wrote 「광장」?

exp.zh: 《광장》是최인훈的长篇，描写南北分裂。
exp.en: 광장 is a novel by 최인훈 about the division of the Koreas.

q.en: Who wrote 「채식주의자」?

exp.zh: 《채식주의자》是한강的小说，2016年获布克国际奖。
exp.en: 채식주의자 is a novel by 한강, which won the Man Booker International Prize in 2016.

papers.titleZh: 试卷 5：语法综合辨析（문법 종합辨析）

q.zh: 비가 오___ 우산이 없어요.（在下雨，可我没伞）
q.en: 비가 오___ 우산이 없어요. (It's raining, but I have no umbrella)

exp.zh: -는데 表背景铺垫＋轻微转折：在下雨，可没伞。
exp.en: -는데 sets the background and a mild contrast: it's raining, but no umbrella.

q.zh: 비가 오___ 못 갔어요.（因为下雨没去）
q.en: 비가 오___ 못 갔어요. (Because it rained, I couldn't go)

exp.zh: -아/어서 表原因，后面不能接命令句。
exp.en: -아/어서 marks cause, and cannot precede a command.

q.zh: 늦잠을 자___ 지각했어요.（因为睡懒觉迟到，负面意外）
q.en: 늦잠을 자___ 지각했어요. (Because I overslept, I was late — negative, unexpected)

exp.zh: -는 바람에 表意外原因导致负面结果。
exp.en: -는 바람에 marks an unexpected cause leading to a negative result.

q.zh: 어제는 춥___ 오늘은 따뜻해요.（昨天冷，今天暖）
q.en: 어제는 춥___ 오늘은 따뜻해요. (Yesterday was cold, today is warm)

exp.zh: -더니 表我观察到的过去事实，以及由此产生的变化。
exp.en: -더니 marks an observed past fact and the resulting change.

q.zh: 음악을 들___ 공부해요.（边听音乐边学习）
q.en: 음악을 들___ 공부해요. (I study while listening to music)

exp.zh: -면서 表两个动作同时进行。
exp.en: -면서 marks two actions happening simultaneously.

q.zh: 书面语中「为了学韩语去韩国」用哪个？
q.en: In written Korean, which ending expresses 'went to Korea to learn Korean'?

exp.zh: -고자 是 -려고 的书面语形式。
exp.en: -고자 is the written equivalent of -려고.

q.zh: 잊지 않___ 메모하세요.（为了不忘记而记笔记）
q.en: 잊지 않___ 메모하세요. (Take notes so as not to forget)

exp.zh: -도록 表目的（使得…）。
exp.en: -도록 marks purpose ('so that ...').

q.zh: 비가 오___ 우산을 샀어요.（看到下雨所以买了伞）
q.en: 비가 오___ 우산을 샀어요. (Saw that it was raining, so I bought an umbrella)

exp.zh: -길래 表因为看到/听到某事而做出的反应。
exp.en: -길래 marks a reaction after seeing or hearing something.

q.zh: 비가 오___ 우산을 챙겨요.（如果下雨就带伞）
q.en: 비가 오___ 우산을 챙겨요. (If it rains, take an umbrella)

exp.zh: -거든 表假设条件（如果）。
exp.en: -거든 marks a hypothetical condition ('if').

q.zh: 아무리 바쁘___ 밥은 먹어요.（即使忙也吃饭）
q.en: 아무리 바쁘___ 밥은 먹어요. (Even if I'm busy, I eat)

exp.zh: -더라도 表让步（即使…也），常与 아무리 搭配。
exp.en: -더라도 marks concession ('even if'), often paired with 아무리.
